sa: महानदी चर्मराशेरुत्क्लेदात् ससृजे यतः। ततश्चर्मण्वतीत्येवं विख्याता सा महानदी॥
en: The secretions that came out of the skins of the animals produced a strong and celebrated river which till now passes by the name of Charmanvati.

sa: दशैश्च पूर्णमासैश्च चातुर्मास्यैः पुनः पुनः। अयजद्धयमेधेन सहस्रं परिवत्सरान्॥
en: On days of the new moon, on those of the full moon, and on every fourth month, for a thousand years, Gaya repeatedly celebrated the Horse-sacrifice.

sa: ततोऽब्रवीद् धर्मसुतो रौहिणेयमरिंदमम्॥ इदं भ्रात्रोर्महायुद्धं पश्य रामेति भारत।
en: Then Dharma's son, O Bharata, said to that chastiser of foes, viz., the son of Rohini "Witness, O Rama, this dreadful encounter between the two brothers."

sa: तत्र कोशं बलं मित्रं व्यवहारं च वर्धयेत्। पुरे जनपदे चैव सर्वदोषान् निवर्तयेत्॥
en: Living there, the king should always try to fill his treasury, to increase his army, multiply the number of his friends, and establish courts of justice. He should suppress all abuses and evils in both his cities and provinces.

sa: महदासीत् तयोर्युद्धं चित्ररूपं भयानकम्। यादृशं समरे पूर्वं जम्भवासवयोर्युधि॥
en: The encounter between the two was beautiful and dreadful, like that which took place in days of yore between Vasava and the Asura Jambha, O lord.

sa: अरयो मे समुत्थाय बहुभिर्दस्युभिः सह। इदमात्मवधायैव राष्ट्रमिच्छन्ति बाधितुम्॥
en: Many enemies of mine, having risen up and combined with a large body of robbers, wish to put our kingdom into difficulties, for themselves being destroyed.

sa: आददीत बलिं चापि प्रजाभ्यः कुरुनन्दन। स षड्भागमपि प्राज्ञस्तासामेवाभिगुप्तये॥
en: The king, O delighter of the Kurus, should take a sixth of the incomes of his subjects as tribute for performing the duties of their protection.

sa: कामिदानीं नरव्याघ्र श्लक्ष्णया स्मितया गिरा। पितृलोके समेत्यान्यां मामिवामन्त्रयिष्यसि॥
en: Having gone to the region of the departed manes, whom else, like me, do you address now, O foremost of men, in sweet and smiling words.

sa: तयोः प्रहर्षमालक्ष्य हर्षाश्रूण्यवर्तयत्। राधेयं निहतं मत्वा समुत्तस्थौ युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Seeing them cheerful and with great wounds on their person Yudhishthira thought that the son of Radha was dead and speedily got up from his seat.

sa: तस्मात् सर्वास्ववस्थासु रक्षेज्जीवितमात्मनः॥ द्रव्याणि संततिश्चैव सर्वं भवति जीवितः।
en: For these reasons one should, under every circumstances, protect his own self. One's possessions, children and everything else are so long valuable as he is alive.

sa: अपध्यानमलो धर्मो मलोऽर्थस्य निगूहनम्। सम्प्रमोदमल: कामो भूयः स्वगुणवर्जितः॥
en: The defeat of Virtue consists in the desire of reward; that of Profit consists in amassing it; when freed from these impurities, they yield mighty fruits.

sa: अहमेतत् करोमीति मन्यते कालनोदितः। यद् यदिष्टमसंतोषाद् दुरात्मा पापमाचरेत्॥
en: Discontented with his position, whatever sins a wicked man commits, under the influence of destiny, saying,-I am the doer,-he considers to be all for his good.

sa: हन्तारं परसैन्यानां शूरं समितिशोभनम्। निबर्हणममित्राणां दुःसहं विषहेत कः॥
en: Who again could stand before my son Dussaha, that destroyer of heroic enemies, that hero, that ornament of assemblies, that irresistible warrior, that resister of foes.

sa: तेषां परमदुः :खानां बुद्ध्या भैषज्यमाचरेत्। सर्वप्राणभृतां वृत्तं प्रेक्षमाणस्ततस्ततः॥
en: Carefully observing the conduct of all creatures, a king should, by the exercise of his intelligence, concert measures for alleviating the great sorrows of his subjects.

sa: दण्डनीत्यां यदा राजा त्रीनंशाननुवर्तते। चतुर्थमंशमुत्सृज्य तदा त्रेता प्रवर्तते॥
en: When the king depends upon only three of the four parts of the science of punishment leaving out a fourth, the age called Treta sets in.

sa: तयैव सहिता चापि पुत्रैरनुगता नृप॥ अभ्यगच्छत गान्धारीमार्तामार्ततरा स्वयम्।
en: Then Kunti, accompanied by the princess of Panchala, and followed by her sons proceeded towards the grief-afflicted Gandhari, though she herself was also in great sorrow.

sa: विषयाचैव कात्स्न्येन सर्व आहारसिद्धये। मूलमेतत् त्रिवर्गस्य निवृत्तिर्मोक्ष उच्यते॥
en: All objects exist in a body for gratifying the desire of enjoyment. Upon these dependent the threefold objects of life. Renunciation of all objects is liberation.

sa: एष संग्रामशूरेण प्रतिज्ञा पालयिष्यता। दुर्मुखोऽभिमुखः शेते हतोऽरिगणहा रणे॥
en: There, my son Durmuksha, that destroyer of a great number of enemies, sleeps facing the enemy, slain by the heroic Bhiinasena in satisfaction of his promisc.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच केन वृत्तेन वृत्तज्ञ वर्तमानो महीपतिः। सुखेनार्थान् सुखोदर्कानिह च प्रेत्य चाप्नुयात्॥
en: Yudhishthira said By following what conduct, O you who are a master of every kind of behaviour, can a king succeed in easily acquiring, both in this world and in the next, objects which yield happiness in the end?

sa: भीममेवाभ्यवर्तन्त रणेऽन्ये तु पदातयः। प्रक्ष्वेड्यास्फोट्य संहृष्टा वीरलोकं यियासवः॥
en: Other foot-soldiers, all actuated with the desire of victory, proceeded against Bhima, uttering loud cries and slapping their armpits, by the desire of going to heaven.

sa: अहं ह्यतितनुश्चैव वानरश्च विशेषतः। वाचं चोदाहरिष्यामि मानुषीमिह संस्कृताम्॥
en: And a puny monkey as I am, I shall speak in Sanskrit (The language refined by the strict rules of grammar) which men delight to use.

sa: अयोध्या प्रति यास्यामि राजधानी पितुर्मम। अभ्यनुज्ञातुमिच्छामि सर्वानामन्त्रयामि वः॥
en: I wish to return to Ayodhyā, the capital of my father's (Kingdom). I wish to obtain your permission (and for this, I have invited you all.

sa: उपायैरभिगच्छाम यथा नदनदीपतिम्। तराम तरसा सर्वे ससैन्या वरुणालयम्॥
en: Do you inform us of the means by which we may cross over, along with our army, the lord of rivers and streams-the abode of Varuna."

sa: आग्नेयेनापि संयुक्तं गृहीत्वा रावणः शरम्। ध्वजशीर्णस्थितं नीलमुर्दक्षत निशाचरः॥
en: Then taking a fiery shaft and setting the same on his bow, that night-ranger Rāvaņa gazed at Nila who was on the tip of his banner.

sa: तां रात्रिमुषितं रामं सुखोदितमरिंदमम्। अब्रवीत्प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं जयं पृष्ट्वा विभीषणः॥
en: Rāma having spent that night happily and risen up the next morning, Vibhisana, chanting his victory, spoke to that slayer of foes, with folded hands, saying.

sa: पातयित्वा ततश्चक्षुः सर्वतो रघुनन्दनः। अब्रवीन्मैथिली सीतां रामः शशिनिभाननाम्।२।।
en: Casting his looks on all sides, Rama, the descendant of Raghus, spoke to Sītā, the daughter of the kind of Mithila, having a moonlike countenance, saying.

sa: तां प्रविश्य गुहां रम्यां रत्नकाञ्चनकुट्टिमाम्। ददृशुर्नैर्ऋतव्याघ्राः शयानं भीमविक्रमम्॥
en: Then entering that charming cave having floors paved with gold and gems. those Naiſtas endowed with great strength, saw that one of dreadful prowess, lying down.

sa: आगतो रक्षसां राजा छत्रचामरसंयुतः। सीतापहारी दुर्वृत्तो ब्रह्मघ्नो देवकण्टकः।। योद्धं रघुवरेणेति शुश्रुवे कलहध्वनिः॥
en: The lord of the Rākṣasa-wicked, the slayer of the Brahmins-the thorn of the celestials, and who has brought away Sītā by stealth, has come with his umbrellas and chowries to fight with the foremost of Raghus-this cry heard everywhere.

sa: तेषामापततां शब्दः कुद्धानामपि गर्जताम्। उद्वर्त इव सत्त्वानां समुद्राणामभूत्स्वनः॥
en: The roars of those beings as they advanced, sending up shouts in anger, resembled the dashing of the Ocean at the time of the universal dissolution.

sa: ततो नानाप्रहरणा भीमाक्षा भीमदर्शनाः। निष्पेतू राक्षसा मुख्या बलाध्यक्षप्रचोदिताः॥
en: Then equipped with various arms, the foremost of Rākşasas, having dreadful eyes (in their heads, and of dreadful forms, marched forth, urged on by their general.

sa: प्रविशन्तीव गात्राणि स्वानि सा जनकात्मजा। वाक्शरैस्तैः सशल्येव भृशमश्रूण्यवर्तयत्॥
en: As if entering to her own person (with shame) and greatly pained with these arrow like words the daughter of king Janaka began to shed tears.

sa: पातयित्वा ततश्चक्षुः सर्वतो रघुनन्दनः। अब्रवीन्मैथिली सीतां रामः शशिनिभाननाम्।२।।
en: Casting his looks on all sides, Rama, the descendant of Raghus, spoke to Sītā, the daughter of the kind of Mithila, having a moonlike countenance, saying.

sa: आजानुलम्बिबाहुः स महावक्षाः प्रतापवान्। लक्ष्मणानुचरो रामः शशास पृथिवीमिमाम्॥
en: That highly powerful Rāma, having his arms extended up to the knee-joint, having a spacious breast and Lakşmaņa as his attendant, ruled the earth (in this.wise).

sa: रक्षाम इति तत्रान्यैर्यक्षाम इति चापरैः। @क्षिता क्षितैरुक्तस्ततस्तानाह भूतकृतः॥
en: Thereat some said 'Raksama,' (i.e. we shall protect.) and others 'Yaksāma.' (We shall worship.) Thus accosted by those afflicted with hunger and thirst, the creator said.

sa: तमप्रविष्टं न्यग्रोधं बलिनं रावणात्मजम्। विध्वंसय शरैर्दीप्तैः सरथं साश्वसारथिम्॥
en: Do you, ere he has passed beyond the Nyagrodha, with flaming arrows destroy the powerful son of Rävaņa along with his car and steeds and charioteer.

sa: ततः प्रकृतिमापनो हृतशल्यो गतक्लमः। सौमित्रिMमुदे तत्र क्षणेन विगतज्वरः॥
en: And restored to his natural condition, Sumitrā's son, healed, and with his exhaustion removed, and his suffering gone off in a moment, experienced exhilaration of spirits.

sa: खरोष्ट्रश्वतरा राजन्भिन्नरोमाः सवन्ति च। न स्वभावेऽवतिष्ठन्ते विधानैरपि चिन्तिताः॥
en: Asses, camels and mules, O king, with their hair standing erect, shed tears; and although they are ministered to medically, they do not return to nature.

sa: ततः पौलस्त्यसचिवाः श्रुत्वा चेन्द्रजितो वधम्। आचचक्षुरवज्ञाय दशग्रीवाय सत्वराः॥
en: Then the counsellors of Pulastya's son, hearing of Indrajit having been slain, speedily conveyed the tidings to the Ten-necked one, who was ignorant* of the same.

sa: रथैश्चातिरथाः शीघ्रं मत्तैश्च वरवारणैः। अनूत्पेतुर्दशग्रीवमाक्रीडद्भिश्च वाजिभिः॥ गदापरिघहस्ताश्च शक्तितोमरपाणयः।
en: And many atiratha heroes went with cars, and superb mad elephants, and sportive steeds; and bearing in their hands maces and bludgeons; and darts and clubs.

sa: तस्योत्पतनवेगेन निधूतास्तत्र राक्षसाः। भूमौ निपतिताः सर्वे राक्षसेन्द्रस्य पश्यतः॥
en: Thereat, in consequence of the impetuosity of his bound, the Raksasas, slipping off, fell on to the ground in the very sight of the Rākṣasa king.

sa: तेषां नो विप्रनष्टानां विन्ध्ये पर्वतसत्तमे। भृशं शोकाभितप्तानां महान्कालोऽत्यवर्तत॥
en: Among them some of us lost our way in a cavity of the Vindhya mountain, and were stricken with great terror-and accordingly much time was lost.

sa: ततस्त्वेकं घटं गृह्य संस्थाप्य परमासने॥ घटेन तेन सौमित्रिरभ्यषिञ्चद्विभीषणम्। लङ्कायां रक्षसां मध्ये राजानं रामशासनात्॥ विधिना मन्त्रदृष्टेन सुहृद्गणसमावृतः। अभ्यषिञ्चस्तदा सर्वे राक्षसा वानरास्तथा॥
en: Taking that jar and placing him on an excellent seat Saumitri with that water sprinkled Vibhīşaņa as king of Lankā in the presence of all the Raksasas, at Rama' command. And (Laks maņa) encircled by friends sprinkling him according to rites laid down in the Vedas, all the Rākşasas, devoted to him, his counsellors and the monkeys attaining incomparable delight, sang the glory of Rāma.

sa: ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः। समीयुद्वैरथं द्रष्टुं रावणक्षयकाङ्क्षिणः॥
en: Then desirous of destruction of Rāvana, celestials with Gandharvas, and Siddhas and supersaints assembled to go to behold the encounter taking place between the two cars.

sa: तन्मुच्यतां महाबाहो महेन्द्रः पाकशासनः। किंचास्य मोक्षणार्थाय प्रयच्छन्तु दिवौकसः॥
en: Do you therefore, O you having long arms, release Mahendra, she chastiser of Pāka and for setting him free what do you want from the celestials?

sa: मोचितो रामवाक्येन वानरैश्च निपीडितः। शुकः परमसंत्रस्तो रक्षोधिपमुपागमत् ॥
en: Liberated at the word of Rama, Suka, who had been sore tormented by the monkeys, oppressed with exceeding great fear, went to the lord of Raksasas.

sa: अभ्यगच्छत्ततो रामं विचित्राभरणाम्बरा। त्रिविष्टपे सहस्र समुपविष्टं यथा शची॥
en: Thereupon wearing a beautifully coloured cloth and being adorned with various ornaments Sītā appeared before Rāma like to ſací approaching the king of celestials in heaven.

sa: तस्यैते निशितास्तीक्ष्णाः पत्रिपत्राङ्गवाजिनः। पतत्रिण इवासौम्याः शराः पास्यन्ति शोणितम्॥
en: These keen and sharpened shafts of his, attaining access of velocity through the feathers of birds, and themselves resembling fierce fowls, will drink his* blood. *Indrajit's.

sa: तावुभौ युगपद्वीरौ हनूमद्राक्षसोत्तमौ। उल्काहस्तौ तदा रात्रौ रणशीर्षे विचेरतुः॥
en: Those two great heroes— Hanumān and that foremost of the Rakşasas, with fire-brands in their hands, began to range to and fro in the battle field.

sa: महानयं वरस्तात यस्त्वयोक्तो रघूत्तम। द्विर्मया नोक्तपूर्वं च तस्मादेतद्भविष्यति॥
en: O my boy, O foremost of the Raghus, mighty is the boon you have prayed for-my words shall never be falsified, so let them be fulfilled.

sa: ताञ्छरौघांस्ततो भल्लैस्तीक्ष्णैश्चिच्छेद राघवः। दीप्यमानान्महाघोराञ्छरानाशीविषोपमान्॥
en: Rāghava sundered with his sharp Bhalla his dreadful flaming and resembling poisonous serpents.

sa: तस्य जृम्भितविक्षेपाव्यामिश्रा वै दिशो दश। रूपवानिव रुद्रस्य मन्युर्गात्रेष्वदृश्यत॥
en: And as he yawned, the wind (blowing) from his mouth), filled the ten cardinal regions; and his wrath resembled that appearing in the person of Rudra.

sa: सोऽन्यत्कार्मुकमादाय सज्ज चक्रे त्वरत्रिव। तदप्यस्य त्रिभिर्बाणैर्लक्ष्मणो निरकृन्तत ॥
en: Thereat, taking another bow, (Indrajit) hurriedly fastened the string to it. And this bow also did Lakşmaņa cut off by means of a brace of arrows.

sa: यश्चैष शक्त्या निहतस्त्वयाद्य गच्छन्विषादं सहसाभ्युपेत्य। स एष रक्षोगणराजमृत्युः सपुत्रपौत्रस्य तवाद्य युद्धे ॥
en: And (Laksmana), going forth to the fight, has been wounded with the dart and has suddenly been stupefied. But, o king of the Rākşasa today in conflict Death shall claim for his own you and your sons and grandsons.

sa: पादमूलगताश्चापि ददर्श सुमहात्मनः। पत्नी: स प्रियभार्यस्य तस्य रक्ष:पतेगुहे॥
en: He (Hanumān) also saw in the mansion of the Rākşas chief, the wives of that huge bodied one dear to his wives, lying at his feet.

sa: सा तयोः कुशलं देवी निशम्य नरसिंहयोः। प्रतिसंहृष्टसर्वाङ्गी हनूमन्तमथाब्रवीत्॥
en: Hearing of the welfare of those two lions among men, the worshipful dame, with all her frame worked up with rapture, again spake to Hanumān, saying.

sa: वानरेन्द्र महेन्द्राभ राक्षसेन्द्रोऽस्मि रावणः। युद्धेप्सुरिह संप्राप्तः स चाद्यासादितस्त्वया॥
en: O king of monkeys, resembling Mahendra, I am Rāvaņa, the king of Rākşasas; I came here to fight: but I have been defeated by you. Alas!

sa: स तत्र मायाबलवानदृश्योऽथान्तरिक्षगः। इन्द्रं मायापरिक्षिप्तं कृत्वा स प्राद्रवच्छरैः॥
en: Being invisible in the welkin by virtue of his illusory powers and having brought Indra under the influence thereof he struck him with hundreds of arrows.

sa: एष सर्वायुधोपेतश्चतुर्भिः सह राक्षसैः। राक्षसोऽभ्येति पश्यध्वमस्मान्हन्तुं न संशयः।७।।
en: Behold, there comes a Rākşasa, armed with various weapons and followed by four demons to slay us and there is not the least doubt about it.

sa: हरयोऽपि महात्मानो ददृशू राक्षसं बलम्॥ हस्त्यश्वरथसंबाधं किङ्किणीशतनादितम्। नीलजीमूतसंकाशं समुद्यतमहायुधम्॥ दीप्तानलरविप्रख्यैनैर्ऋतैः सर्वतो वृतम्।
en: The high souled monkeys also saw that mighty host of Räkşasas thronging with elephants, horses and cars, and ringing with hundreds of bell-lets; resembling dark-blue clouds; upraising mighty arms; and environed on all sides by Naiſtas resembling flaming fire.

sa: अब्रीवच्च वरारोहां सीतां सुरसुतोपमाम्। अपत्यलाभो वैदेहि त्वय्ययं समुपस्थितः॥
en: Thereupon he said to the beautiful Sītā resembling a celestial damsel:-"0 Vaidehi, signs of pregnancy are manifest in you. What desires of your can we satisfy?"

sa: अहमुत्सादयिष्यामि शबूंस्तव महाबलान्। यदि शक्रो यदि यमो यदि पावकमारुतौ।॥ तानहं योधयिष्यामि कुबेरवरुणावपि।
en: I shall abolish your foes endowed with redoubted might. If even Śakra himself, and Yama, and the god of Fire, and the god of Wind, and Kubera, and Varuņa-shall range themselves against me, them shall I encounter in fight.

sa: सशरैरद्य वदनैः संख्ये वानरयूथपाः। मण्डयिष्यन्ति वसुधां सनालैरिव पङ्कजैः॥
en: To-day in the encounter, the leaders of the monkey hosts, with their heads transfixed with arrows, shall cover the earth, like to Ictuses with their stalks.

sa: विनेदुर्मुदिताः केचित् केचित् किलकिला तथा। हृष्टा पादपशाखाश्च आनिन्युर्वानरर्षभाः॥
en: And some, filled with delight, sent shouts, and some raised ululations; and the foremost monkeys fetched branches of trees. (To serve for a seat for Hanuman)

sa: स ददर्श महावीयौँ नागौ त्रिशिरसाविव। सृजन्ताविषुजालानि वीरौ वानरमध्यगौ॥
en: He beheld there those two heroes discharging flaming arrows and surrounded by the monkeys like to the fearful three-hooded serpent in the midst of other serpents.

sa: रक्षसां रुवतां रावं श्रुत्वा हरिहयानुजः। तिर्यगास्थाय संक्रुद्धः पक्षीशे भगवान्हरिः॥ पराङ्मुखोऽप्युत्ससर्ज मालेश्चक्रं जिघांसया।
en: Hearing the cheers of the Raksasa, Indra's younger brother, the reverend Hari, sitting on that lord of birds, albeit moved off from the scene of conflict, waxing enraged, from a desire of slaying (Mali) hurled his disc at him.

sa: युद्धप्रमत्तो व्याक्षिप्तो जयाकाङ्क्षी क्षिपशरान्।।३३ नाहमज्ञासिषं युध्यन्स्वान्परान्वापि संयुगे। जामातरं न जाने स्म प्रहरन्युद्धदुर्मदः॥
en: Being mad after war-fare and desirous of acquiring victory, I was continually making a downpour of shafts, so I could not distinguish in the conflict between my own men and enemies, and thus unwittingly I did hurt your husband.

sa: अपापास्तत्कुलीनाश्च मानयन्ति स्वकान्हितान्। एष प्रायो नरेन्द्राणां शङ्कनीयस्तु शोभनः॥
en: Those kinsmen, who do not think of one another's mischief, generally long for their respective well-being. But even such wellmeaning relatives are feared by the kings.

sa: रावणस्तु महावीर्यो निषण्णः शैलमूर्धनि स ददर्श गुणांस्तत्र चन्द्रपादपशोभितान्॥
en: And lying down on the summit of the mountain, the highly powerful Rāvaņa espied the caves beautified with the rays of the moon and the trees.

sa: दिष्ट्या त्वया हतो राम रावणः पुत्रपौत्रवान्। दिष्ट्या विजयिनं त्वाद्य पश्यामः सह सीतया॥ लक्ष्मणेन च धर्मात्मन्ध्रात्रा त्वद्धितकारिणा। मातृभिर्धातृसहितं पश्यामोऽद्य वयं नृप॥
en: By good fortune it is, O Rama, that Ravana along with his sons and grandsons has been slain by you. By good fortune it is that today we see you victorious along with $ītā, and, O righteoussouled one, with your brother, Lakşmaņa, (ever) compassing your profit. (By good fortune it is) that, Oking, today we behold (you) in company with your mothers and your brothers.

sa: अर्जुनाभिमुखे तस्मिन्रावणे राक्षसाधिपे। चण्डः प्रवाति पवनः सनादः सरजस्तथा॥
en: Ravana, the lord of Raksasas, having set out with a hostile intention against Kārtavīryarjuna, the wind mixed with dust began to blow high with tumultuous sound.

sa: निरायुधानां क्रमतामसङ्गगतिपौरुषाः। दारा ह्युपहसिष्यन्ति स वै घातः सुजीवताम्॥
en: You poltroons, if you fly away leaving your arms behind, your wives shall deride you; and that is more painful to honourable persons than death itself.

sa: अश्रुपूर्णमुखीं दीनां कृशामनशनेन च। शोकध्यानपरां दीनां नित्यं दुःखपरायणाम्॥
en: She was greatly reduced by fast, stricken with grief and anxious thoughts, disturbed with sorrow and was poorly and her eyes were always full of tears.

sa: दिष्ट्यासि मे राघव दृष्टिमार्ग प्राप्तऽन्तगामी विपरीतबुद्धिः। अस्मिन्क्षणे यास्यसि मृत्युलोकं संसाद्यमानो मम बाणजालैः।१४॥
en: O Raghu's son, by my luck have you of perverse sense, finding your fate come within the range of my ken. This very instant, tormented with the springs of my shafts, you will repair to the regions of Death.

sa: एतद्विनापि ह्युदधेस्तवाद्य संपत्स्यते वीरतमस्य कार्यम्। भवद्विधाः क्रोधवशं न यान्ति दीर्घं भवान्पश्यतु साधुवृत्तम्॥
en: Without doing this to the Ocean, you supreme of heroes, may have your work accomplished. Personages like you do not come under the influence of passion. Do you deliberately look about for some worthy means (for compassing your end.)

sa: एवमुक्त्वा धनुष्पाणिः क्रोधविस्फारितेक्षणः। बभूव रामो दुर्धर्षो युगान्ताग्निरिव ज्वलन्॥
en: Having spoken you, Rāma, equipped with his bow, with his eyes dilated in wrath, became exceedingly irrepressible, like to the flaming fire at the final dissolution.

sa: तस्मात् त्वमपि वार्ष्णेय द्विजान् पूजय नित्यदा। पूजिताः पूजनार्हा हि सुखं दास्यन्ति तेऽनघ।॥
en: For these reasons, do you also O scion of Vrishni's race, adore every day those twiceborn persons of whom I speak. Worthy as they are of reverent worship, they will when adored confer happiness on you, O sinless one,

sa: ततः कदाचित् ते राजन् दीप्तमादित्यवर्चसम्। ददृशुस्तेजसा युक्तमगस्त्यं विपुलव्रतम्॥
en: One day, in course of their wanderings, they met Agastya of high vows, that Brahimana, O king, who was gifted with great energy and solar splendour.

sa: इत्थं च परितुष्टं मां विजानीहि भृगूद्वह। युवा षोडशवर्षो हि यद्यद्य भविता भवान्॥ ददानि पत्नी कन्यां च स्वां ते दुहितरं द्विजा एतामृतेऽङ्गना नान्या त्वत्तेऽर्हति सेवितुम्॥
en: Know, O perpetuator of Bhrigu's race, that I have been highly pleased with your conduct. Know, Operpetuator of Bhrigu's race, that I have been very much pleased with you for this. If you become a young man today of sixteen years, I shall confer on you, O twice-born years, I shall confer on you. O twice-born one, this my own daughter for becoming your wife. No other woman except this one is capable of waiting upon your energy.

sa: दिवसे यस्तु षष्ठे वै मुनिः प्राशेत भोजनम्॥ सदा द्वादशमासान् वै जुह्वानो जातवेदसम्। सदा त्रिषवणस्नायी ब्रह्मचार्यनसूयकः॥ गवां मेधस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमम्।
en: He who fasting for five days, takes food only on the sixth day, and pious libations on his sacred fire every day for one year, and who performs three ablutions in course of the day for purifying himself and saying his prayers and paying his adoration, and who leads a celibate life, divested of malice in his conduct, acquires the merit of the Gomedha sacrifice.

sa: पुत्र उवाच अपत्यमस्मि ते पुंसस्त्राणात् पुत्र इति स्मृतः। आत्मा पुत्रः स्मृतस्तस्मात् बाह्यात्मानमिहात्मना॥
en: The Son said-I am your offspring. The Shruti declare that one's offspring is called Putra, because one is rescued by him. One's own self, again, takes birth as his son. Do you, therefore, rescue yourself by your own self.

sa: घोरे तमस्ययुध्यन्त सहिता देवदानवाः। अविध्यत शरैस्तत्र स्वर्भानुः सोमभास्करौ॥
en: Once on a time as the gods and Danavas were fighting each other in the dark, Rahu pierced both the Sun and Moon with his arrows.

sa: वैशाख्यां पौर्णमास्यां तु तिलान् दद्याद् द्विजातिषु। तिला भक्षयितव्याश्च सदा त्वालम्भनं च तैः॥
en: One should, on the day of the full moon of the month of Vaishakha, make gifts of sesame to the Brahmanas. They should also be made to cat and to touch sesame on every occasion that one can afford.

sa: अथ सर्वमुपन्यस्तमग्रतश्च्यवनस्य तत्। ततः सर्वं समानीय तच्च शय्यासनं मुनिः॥ वस्त्रैः शुभैरवच्छाद्य भोजनोपस्करैः सह। सर्वमादीपयामास च्यवनो भृगुनन्दनः॥
en: All this food, brought from the kitchen, was placed before Chyavana. A seat was also placed for him and a bed too was spread. The dishes were then caused to be covered with white cloths. Soon, however, Chyavana of Bhrigu's race put fire to all the things and reduced them to ashes.

sa: अन्वाहार्ये महाराज पितॄणां श्राद्धमुच्यते। तस्माद् विशेषविधिना विधिः प्रथमकल्पितः॥
en: It is said, O king, that the Shraddha perforined in honour of the departed Manes is performable afterwards. But this general rule has a special restraint.

sa: क्षीणस्याप्यायनं दृष्टं क्षतस्य क्षतरोहणम्। व्याधितस्यौषधग्रामः क्रुद्धस्य च प्रसादनम्॥ दुःखितस्यार्थमानाभ्यां दुःखानां प्रतिषेधनम्। न चैते स्वर्गकामस्य रोचन्ते सुखमेधसः॥
en: The person who seeks Heaven, does not want strength when he becomes weak, or the cure of wounds when he is wounded, or the administration of medicine when he is ill, or soothings, by others when he is angry, or the mitigation, by the expenditure of money, of sorrows caused by poverty.

sa: तत्र संगणना नास्ति राज्ञामयुतशस्तदा। येऽयुध्यन्त महाराज क्षत्रिया हतबान्धवाः॥
en: O monarch, many Kshatriyas and kings, who fought with Arjuna on that occasion, were rendered miserable for having lost their kinsmen on the field of Kurukshetra.

sa: तथैवापततां तेषां योधानां जयगृद्धिनाम्॥ शिरांसि पातयामास भल्लैः संनतपर्वभिः।
en: With many straight and broad headed arrows, he cut off the heads of many of those warriors who were rushing at him from desire of victory.

sa: शय्यासनानि यानानि योगयुक्ते तपोधने। अग्निप्रवेशे नियतं ब्रह्मलोके महीयते॥
en: Those who lie on the hard and bare ground acquire houses and beds. Those who clothe themselves in rags and barks get good dresses and ornaments.

sa: तस्य लोकप्रधानस्य जगन्नाथस्य भूपते। विष्णोर्नामसहस्रं मे शृणु पापभयापहम्॥
en: Hear, O king, the thousand names, highly efficacious in dissipating sins, of that Foremost One in all the worlds, that Master of the universe, viz., Vishnu.

sa: अपश्यं तत्र वेश्मानि तैजसानि महात्मनाम्। नानासंस्थानरूपाणि सर्वरत्नमयानि च॥
en: I saw in those regions many effulgent palaces intended for great persons. Those mansions are of various forns and are adorned with every kind of gems.

sa: जलेश्वरस्तु हृत्वा तामनयत् स्वं पुरं प्रति। परमाद्भुतसंकाशं षट्सहस्रशतह्रदम्॥
en: Abducting her thus, the Lord of the waters took her to his own house. That mansion was wonderful. It was adorned with six hundred thousand lakes.

sa: मृगयूथैरनुद्विग्नस्तत्र तत्र समाश्रितैः। अशङ्कितैः पक्षिगणैः प्रगीतैरिव च प्रभो॥
en: Herds of deer were grazing or resting here and there, shorn of fear. Countless birds also were there, engaged in uttering their sweet notes, O king!

sa: मुहूर्तयाते तस्मिंस्तु देवशर्मा महातपाः। कृत्वा यज्ञं यथाकाममाजगाम स्वमाश्रमम्॥
en: A moment after he had gone away, Devasharman of great ascetic merit, having accomplished the sacrifice, he had intended to perform, returned to his own hermitage.

sa: अस्मिन् कालेऽथ सोऽल्पायुर्दिष्टान्तमगमत् प्रभुः। ते तं क्षुधाभिसंतप्ताः परिवार्योपतस्थिरे॥
en: About this time, longlived as the prince was, he died of starvation. The Rishis named, afflicted with hunger, approached the dead prince and sat encircling him.

sa: तस्मात् सक्तून् ग्रहीष्यामि वधु नार्हसि वञ्चनाम्। गणयित्वा महाभागे त्वां हि धर्मभृतां वरे॥
en: Therefore, O daughter-in-law, I shall take your share of the barley. You deserve not to be deceived by me, considering all your virtues. You are truly, O blessed damsel, the foremost of all persons observing the duties of righteousness.

sa: प्राणानामायतत्वेन तमुदानं प्रचक्षते। तस्मात् तपो व्यवस्यन्ति मन्दतं ब्रह्मवादिनः॥
en: Hence, Prana and Apana do not desert a sleeping person. On account of its controlling all the vital airs, the controlling breath is so called Udana.

sa: देवराजस्य समयं कृतमाङ्गिरसेन ह। श्रुत्वा मरुत्तो नृपतिर्यज्ञमाहारयत् परम्॥
en: On hearing of the agreement made by Angira's son Brihaspati with the king of the celestials, king Marutta made the necessary preparations for a great sacrifice.

sa: श्वशुर उवाच अनेन नित्यं साध्वी त्वं शीलवृत्तेन शोभसे। या त्वं धर्मव्रतोपेता गुरुवृत्तिमवेक्षसे॥
en: O chaste lady, on account of such conduct of yours you will for ever shine in glory, for endued with vows and steadiness in rcligious rites, your eyes are directed to that conduct which should be observed towards elders.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच दह्यमानाय विप्राय यः प्रयच्छत्युपानहौ। यत्फलं तस्य भवति तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said I wish to hear, O grandfather what the merits are of that person who makes the gift of a pair of sandals to a Brahmana whose feet are burning or being scorched by hot sands while walking.

sa: रूपमप्रतिमं कृत्वा लोभनीयं जनाधिप। दर्शनीयतमो भूत्वा प्रविवेश तमाश्रमम्॥
en: Indeed, O king, having assumed a form peerless in beauty and highly tempting to women and highly agreeable to look at, Indra entered the ascetic's asylum.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। निबोध दशहोतृणां विधानमथ यादृशम्॥
en: The Brahmana said Regarding it is cited the following ancient story. Do you understand, of what kind the institution is of the ten Hotris (sacrificing priests).

sa: भीष्म उवाच प्राचेतसस्य वचनं कीर्तयन्ति पुराविदः। यस्याः किंचित्राददते ज्ञातयो न स विक्रयः॥
en: Bhishma said They who know the ancient history recite the following verse of Daksha the son of Prachetas, viz.,-That maiden, for whom nothing is taken by her kinsmen in the form of dower, cannot be said to be sold.

sa: भीष्म उवाच शृणु वक्ष्यामि यत् त्वयि। या गतिः प्राप्यते येन प्रेत्यभावे विशाम्पते॥
en: Bhishma said Hear what I say to you. It is highly wonderful and is a great mystery. The subject is the ends that creatures acquire after death as the rewards of particular acts or courses of conduct they follow.

sa: काले कालेऽस्य सम्प्राप्ते नैव विद्येत भोजनम्। क्षुधापरिगताः सर्वे प्रातिष्ठन्त तदा तु ते॥
en: When the habitual hours came for eating, the Brahmana had nothing to eat. This happened day after day. All the members of his family were stricken with hunger but were obliged to pass the days as best they could.

sa: विहारयात्रासु पुनः कुरुराजो युधिष्ठिरः। सर्वान् कामान् महातेजाः प्रददावम्बिकासुते॥
en: On those occasions when the son of Ambika went on pleasure trips, the highly energetic. Kuru king Yudhishthira used to give him every article of enjoyment.

sa: व्यास उवाच एवमुक्तस्त्वाङ्गिरसेन शक्रः समादिदेश स्वयमेव देवान्। सभाः नियन्तामावसथाश्च मुख्याः सहस्रशश्चित्रभूताः समृद्धाः॥ क्लृप्ताः स्थूणाः कुरुतारोहणानि गन्धर्वाणामप्सरसां च शीघ्रम्। यत्र नृत्येरन्नप्सरसः समस्ताः स्वर्गोपमः क्रियतां यज्ञवाटः॥
en: Vyasa said Thus addressed by the son of Angira, Shakra himself gave directions to all the celestials to erect the hall of assembly, and a thousand well-furnished excellent rooms loO king grand as in a canvass and quickly to complete the staircase massive and durable, for the ascent of the Gandharvas and Apsaras and to furnish that portion of the sacrificial ground reserved for the dance of the Apsaras, like the palace of Indra in the celestial region.

sa: ब्राह्मणाः संश्रिताः क्षत्रं न क्षत्रं ब्राह्मणाश्रितम्। श्रिता ब्रह्मोपधा विपाः खादन्ति क्षत्रियान् भुवि॥
en: It is seen that Brahmanas take refuge with Kshatriyas. The Kshatriyas never seek the refuge of Brahmanas. Indeed, throughout the Earth, the Brahmans, accepting such refuge under the pretence of teaching the Vedas, get their maintenance from the Kshatriyas.

sa: तत्रैव तेषां कृत्यानि गङ्गाद्वारेऽन्वशात् तदा। कर्तव्यानीति पुरुषान् दत्तदेयान्महीपतिः॥
en: The king, having rewarded those men beforehand, commanded them to perform those rites of cremation which the bodies of Dhritarashtra and Gandhari and Kunti still awaited.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच हन्त ते कीर्तयिष्यामि नमस्कृत्य कपर्दिने। यदवाप्तं मया राजच्छ्रेयो यच्चार्जितं यशः॥
en: Vasudeva said I shall recite to you the good which I have acquired and the fame which I have won through the favour of that great one. I shall describe to you the subject, after having bowed unto Kaparddin.

sa: स तैर्विद्धो महानागो विस्रवन् रुधिरं बभौ। गौरिकाक्तमिवाम्भोऽद्रिर्बहुप्रस्रवणं तदा।॥
en: Pierced therewith, the powerful elephant, emitting a large quantity of blood, looked like a mountain of many springs discharging rillets of water coloured with red chalk.

sa: ते मूर्ध्नि समुपाघ्राताः सर्वकार्याणि चक्रिरे। कुन्तिभोजसुता चैव गान्धारीमन्ववर्तत॥
en: They did all things under the command of Dhritarashtra who smelt their heads in love. The daughter of king Kuntibhoja also obeyed Gandhari in all matters.

sa: फलं दास्यति ते यत्तु दाने परमिहोच्यते। सुवर्णं यच्च यस्माच्च यथा च गुणवतमम्॥
en: That gold will confer merit on you. Ini matters of gifts, gold is highly spoken of. I shall also tell you what is gold, whence it has come, and how it has come to be endued with superior attributes.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच गुणाज्ञानमविज्ञानं गुणज्ञानमभिज्ञता। परस्परं गुणानेते नाभिजानन्ति कर्हिचित्॥
en: Not knowing the qualities is ignorance; while knowledge of the qualities is knowledge. These seven never succeed in apprehending or knowing the qualitics of one another.

sa: कार्यार्थं निर्गतं चापि भार्तारं गृहमागतम्। आसनेनोपसंयोज्य पूजयामि समाहिता॥
en: When my husband, having left home upon any business, used to return, I always served him by giving him a seat, and adored him with respect.

sa: वैवस्वतस्य सदनं न स गच्छेत् कदाचन। यस्य कन्याहूदे वासो देवलोकं स गच्छति॥
en: One who lives by the side of the tirtha known by the name of Kanvahrada has never to visit the regions of Yama. Such a person is sure to ascend to the regions of happiness belonging to the celestials.

sa: तमायान्तमथालक्ष्य वज्रदत्तस्य वारणम्। गाण्डीवमाश्रित्य बली न व्यकम्पत शत्रुहा॥
en: Seeing that beast of Vajradatta advance towards him, that destroyer of enemies, viz., the powerful Dhananjaya, relaying on Gandiva, stood his ground without shaking with fear.

sa: हिरण्यदानैर्गोदानैर्भूमिदानैश्च सर्वशः। मांसस्याभक्षणे धर्मो विशिष्ट इति नः श्रुतिः॥
en: The merit won by abstaining from meat, we have heard is superior to that of one who makes presents of gold, of kine, and of land.

sa: अधृष्यः सर्वभूतानामायुष्मान् निरुजः सदा। भवत्यभक्षयन् मांसं दयावान् प्राणिनामिह॥
en: By abstaining from meat and showing mercy to all creatures one becomes incapable of being molested by any creature, and acquires longevity perfect health and happiness.

sa: धर्मः किंलक्षणः प्रोक्तः कथं वा चरितुं नरैः। शक्यो धर्ममविन्दद्धिर्धर्मज्ञ वद मे प्रभो॥
en: What are the characteristics of Religion or Duty? How, indeed, do men unacquainted with the details of Religion or Duty succeed in observing them. O powerful lord, O you who are conversant with Religion, do you tell me this.

sa: जनश्च विमनाः सर्वोऽभवत् त्राससमन्वितः। निमीलते भूतपतौ नष्टसूर्य इवाभवत्॥
en: All living creatures became dispirited and filled with fear. Indeed, when the eyes of the lord of all creatures were thus closed, the universe appeared sunless.

sa: ज्ञानविज्ञानसम्पन्नानूहापोह विशारदान्। प्रवक्तृन् पृच्छते योऽन्यान् स वै नापदमृच्छति॥
en: That person never falls into disgrace who asks such speakers as are gifted with knowledge and science and as are well conversant with premises and inferences.

sa: ततोऽस्य रोमकूपेभ्यो धम्यतस्तत्र भारता घनः प्रादुरभूद् धूमो नागलोकभयावहः॥
en: From the pores of his body, O Bharata, on account of his very nature, a thick smoke came out threatening terrors to the world of Nagas.

sa: के च स्मृताः प्रतीघाता येन मर्त्यान् न हिंसथ। रक्षोनानि च कानि स्युर्यगृहेषु प्रणश्यथ। श्रोतुमिच्छाम युष्माकं सर्वमेतन्निशाचराः॥
en: What acts are considered as obstacles to your power? What indeed, are those acts on account of which you cannot afflict men? What are those acts that are destructive of Rakshasas and which prevent you from influencing the dwellings of men? Ye night rangers, we wish to hear all this from you.

sa: अहिंसा सत्यमक्रोधो दानमेतच्चतुष्टयम्। अजातशत्रो सेवस्व धर्म एष सनातनः॥
en: Abstention from injury, truth, absence of anger (or forgiveness), and liberality or gifts, these four, O king do you practise, for these four form eternal virtue.

sa: निवृत्ते पौरवर्गे च राजा सान्त:पुरस्तदा। धृतराष्ट्राभ्यनुज्ञातो निवर्तितुमियेष ह॥
en: After the citizens had ceased following the monarch, king Yudhishthira, with the ladies of his house, prepared to stop, at the command of Dhritarashtra you desist.

sa: यज्ञमित्यपरे विप्राः प्रदानमिति चापरे। तपस्त्वन्ये प्रशंसन्ति स्वाध्यायमपरे जनाः॥
en: Other learned Brahmanas say that it is Sacrifice. Others, again, say that it is gift. Others speak highly of penances. Others, the study of the scriptures.

sa: अथ चेन्मन्यसे सिद्धिमस्मदर्थेषु नित्यदा। घ्राणेन रूपमादत्स्व रसमादत्स्व चक्षुषा॥
en: If, again, you consider your power over our objects to be always complete, do you then seize colour by the nose, and taste by the eye.

sa: निहते कौरवेन्द्रे तु सानुबन्धे सुयोधने। विदुरः संजयश्चैव धर्मराजमुपस्थितौ॥
en: Upon the destruction of the Kaurava-king Suyodhana with all his followers and allies, Vidura and Sanjaya have come to the presence of king Yudhishthira the just.

sa: अथागत्य महातेजा भृगुर्ब्रह्मविदां वरः। अगस्त्यमाश्रमस्थं वै समुपेत्येदमब्रवीत्॥ एवं वयमसत्कारं देवेन्द्रस्यास्य दुर्मतेः। नहुषस्य किमर्थं वै मर्षयाम महामुने॥
en: At that time, Bhrigu, that foremost of all persons conversant with Brahma went to Agastya while the latter was seated in his hermitage, and addressing him said, O great ascetic, why should we patiently suffer such indignities inflicted on us by this wicked Nahusha who has become the king of the deities.

sa: कथमायुरवाप्नोति कथं भवति सत्त्ववान्। कथमव्यङ्गतामेति लक्षण्यो जायते कथम्॥
en: How does one acquire longevity? How does onc acquire strength? How does one acquire faultlessness of limbs? Indeed, how does one become gifted with excellent marks?

sa: सहदेवस्तु कौरव्य समाधास्यति बुद्धिमान्। कुटुम्बतन्त्रं विधिवत् सर्वमेव महायशाः॥
en: Gifted with great intelligence and fame, Sahadeva will, O you of Kuru's race, duly attend to all the relatives who have been invited to your capital.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततस्ते पाण्डवा दूरादवतीर्य पदातयः। अभिजग्मुर्नरपतेराश्रमं विनयानताः॥
en: Vaishampayana said The Pandavas got down at a distance, from their cars and proceeded on foot to the hermitage of the king, bending themselves in humility.

sa: फलमस्य पृथक्त्वेन श्रोतुमर्हन्ति सत्तमाः। प्रलयं सर्वभूतैस्तु गन्तव्यं कालपर्ययात्॥
en: The best of creatures should listen to what the merits are of that duty separately. In course of time every creature is destined to undergo dissolution.

sa: धर्मवैतंसिको यस्तु पापात्मा पुरुषाधमः। ददाति दानं विप्रेभ्यो लोकविश्वासकारणम्॥
en: That low wretch of sin who hypocritically assuming a garb of virtue makes gifts to Brahmanas, only created the conviction in men about his own virtue.

sa: तत्र देवो गिरितटे दिव्यधातुविभूषिते॥ पर्यङ्क इव विभ्राजन्नुपविष्टो महामनाः।
en: The great Mahadeva sat, beautifully on one of the peaks that was adorned with excellent minerals, as if it served the purposes of a fine bedstead.

sa: नाहमात्मार्थमिच्छामि गन्धान् ध्राणगतानपि। तस्मान्मे निर्जिता भूमिर्वशे तिष्ठन्ति नित्यदा॥
en: I do not wish for my own self those smells which are even in my nose. Therefore, the earth, subjugated by me, is always under me.

sa: नाहमात्मार्थमिच्छामि शब्दाश्रोत्रगतानपि। तस्मान्मे निर्जिताः शब्दे वशे तिष्ठन्ति नित्यदा॥
en: I do not wish for own self those sounds, which are in contact with even my car. Therefore, sounds, subjugated by me, are always under me.

sa: पप्रच्छ तमृर्षि चापि वैशम्पायनमच्युतम्। कथावशेषं धर्मज्ञो वनवासस्य सत्तम॥
en: Knowing all duties, he then asked the Rishi Vaishampayana of undecaying glory about the sequel, O best of ascetics, of king Dhritarashtra's residence in the forest.

sa: तेषां तु तरसा पार्थस्तत्रैव परिधावताम्। प्रजहारोत्तमाङ्गानि भल्लैः संनतपर्वभिः॥
en: The Gandharas, through fear, lost their senses and wandered over the field, unable to escape. Arjuna, with his broadheaded arrows, cut off the heads of many.

sa: अन्यथा प्रतिपन्नास्ते विबुद्धाः स्वेष कर्मसु। पुनरावृत्तिधर्माणस्ते भवन्तीह मानुषा:॥
en: Born in orders other then humanity and growing old in their respective deeds, cven thus they become human beings that are, of course, ordained to return.

sa: अशिष्टनिग्रहो नित्यं शिष्टस्य परिपालनम्। एवं शुक्रोऽब्रवीद् धीमानापत्सु भरतर्षभ।॥
en: The highly intelligent Shakra has said that in times of distress the great duty of a king is to punish the wicked and protect the good.

sa: त्रिवर्ग सप्तधा व्यक्तं यो न वेदेह कर्मसु। सङ्गवान् यस्त्रिवर्गेण किं तस्मिन् मुक्तलक्षणम्॥
en: What inarks of Liberation are in him who do not know the true nature of the three-fold objects of life as shown in seven ways in all acts and who, on that account, is attached to that three-fold objects?

sa: तान्येतानि यथोक्तानि सौक्ष्यादीनि जनाधिप। एकार्थसमवेतानि वाक्यं मम निशामय॥
en: Take it for granted, O king, at my word, that these marks of Ambiguity and the others, vhen occurring together, make a complete and intelligible sentence.

sa: इष्टानिष्टविपत्तिश्च व्यवसाय: समाधिता। संशयः प्रतिपत्तिश्च बुद्धेः पञ्चगुणान् विदुः।१०।।
en: Destruction of both good and evil thoughts, perseverance, concentration, decision, and ascertainment of all things depending upon direct evidence, form the five properties of the understanding.

sa: न ह्ययं कस्यचित् कश्चिन्नास्य कश्च न विद्यते। भवत्येको ह्ययं नित्यं शरीरे सुखदुःखभाक्॥
en: This individual soul is no one's relation; there is none again that may be said to belong to him. He is always alone, and he is himself the creator of his own body and his own happiness and misery.

sa: ते विस्मिताः प्रहृष्टाश्च पुत्रसंजीवनात् पुनः॥ बभूवुर्भरतश्रेष्ठ प्रसादाच्छङ्करस्य वै।
en: Indeed, through Shankara's favour, O chief of the Bharatas, those sorrowing kinsmen were filled with wonder and joy at the restoration of their child to life.

sa: अथ धर्मयुगे तस्मिन् योगधर्ममनुष्ठिता। महीमनुचचारैका सुलभा नाम भिक्षुकी॥
en: In the saine golden age, a woman by name sulabha, belonging to the mendicant order, practised the duties of Yoga and travelled over the entire Earth.

sa: सर्वभूतेषु चात्मानं सर्वभूतानि चात्मनि। सम्पश्यन्नोपलिप्येत जले वारिचरो यथा॥
en: Seeing one's Self in all creatures and all creatures in one's self, one should live like acquatic animals living in water without being drenched by it.

sa: ततोऽध्वरजटः स्थाणुर्वेदाध्वरपतिः शिवः। जगाम शरणं देवो ब्रह्माणं परवीरहा।॥
en: Then the divine and sacred Sthanu, that destroyer of hostile heroes, that lord of the Vedas and the scriptures, filled with pity, tried to please Brahma.

sa: अथ यन्मोहसंयुक्तं काये मनसि वा भवेत्। अप्रत_मविज्ञेयं तमस्तदुपधारयेत्॥
en: Whatever state, of the body or the body or the mind, exists with error or carelessness, is the outcome of Ignorance which is incomprehensible and inexplicable.

sa: आत्मना विहितं दुःखामात्मना विहितं सुखम्। गर्भशय्यामुपादाय भुज्यते पौर्वदेहिकम्॥
en: While still in the mother's womb, a creature enjoys or suffers the happiness of the misery that has been ordained for him by his own acts,

sa: संचिन्त्योग्रेण तपसा महात्मानं महेश्वरम्। उशना योगसिद्धात्मा शूलाग्रे प्रत्यदृश्यत्॥
en: Thinking, with the help of his severe penances, of the great Mahadeva, Ushanas, of soul crowned with Yoga-success, put himself on the point of Mahadeva's lance.

sa: भीष्म उवाच गृध्रोऽस्तमित्याह गतो गतो नेति च जम्बुकः। मृतस्य तं परिजनमूचतुस्तौ क्षुधान्वितौ॥
en: Bhishma said The vulture then said to those men, that the sun had set. The jackal said that it was not so. Both the vulture and the jackal fell hungry and thus addressed thc kinsmen of the dead child.

sa: दर्शयिष्यामि ते तेजस्ततो रात्रिरुपागमत्। अथ निश्चित्य मनसा शाल्मलिर्वातकारितम्॥
en: Determining in his mind the extent of the Wind's might and seeing his ownself to be inferior to the god, the Shalmali began to say aside,

sa: स्वस्ति तेऽस्तु गमिष्यामि साधो भुजगसत्तम। स्मरणीयोऽस्मि भवता सम्प्रेषणनियोजनैः॥
en: Blessed be you, I wish to depart hence, O best of Nagas. You should remember me now and then and enquire after me sending your servants.

sa: अन्तकाले बलोत्कर्षाच्छनैः कुर्यादनातुरः। एवं युक्तेन मनसा ज्ञानं यदुपपद्यते॥
en: Knowledge which one acquires gradually by mind devoted to yoga should be made one's own on the verge of death by a forcible stretch of power.

sa: पृथिवी वायुराकाशमापो ज्योतिश्च पञ्चमम्। महाभूतानि भूतानां सर्वेषां प्रभवाप्ययौ॥
en: Earth, air, space, water, and light as the fifth, are considered as Great Creatures. These form both the origin and the destruction of all created objects.

sa: आसुरेः प्रथमं शिष्यं यमाहुश्चिरजीविनम्। पञ्चस्रोतसि यः सत्रमास्ते वर्षसहस्रिकम्॥
en: He was the greatest of all the disciples of Asuri and was called the undying. He had performed a mental Sacrifice lasting for a thousand years.

sa: मृतस्योत्सृष्टदेहस्य पुनर्देहो न विद्यते। नैव मूर्तिप्रदानेन जम्बुकस्य शतैरपि॥
en: He will not regain his life ai the call of the jackal. If a person once dies and deserts his body, this body never regains animation.

sa: महाभूतानीन्द्रियाणि गुणाः सत्त्वं रजस्तमः। त्रेलोक्यं सेश्वरं सर्वमहंकारे प्रतिष्ठितम्॥
en: The five elements, the senses, the qualities of Goodness, Darkness and Ignorance, the three worlds with the Supreme Being himself, and acts, all rest on Self-consciousness.

sa: न चायमपराधोऽस्या ह्यपराधो ह्ययं मम। योऽहमत्राभवं सक्तः पराङ्मुखमुपस्थितः॥
en: She cannot be held responsible for this. The responsibility is mine, since turning away from the Supreme Soul became of my own accord attached to her,

sa: अतीतास्वथ वर्षासु शरत्काल उपस्थिते। प्राजापत्येन विधिना विश्वासात् काममोहितौ॥ तत्रापातयतां राजन् शिरस्यण्डानि खेचरौ।
en: The rainy season passed away and autumn set in. Actuated by desire, the couple approached each other according to the law of the Creator, and with perfect confidence laid their eggs, O king, on the head of that Rishi.

sa: हृदयं पापवृत्तानां पापमाख्याति वैकृतम्। ज्ञानपूर्वं विनश्यन्ति गूहमाना महाजने॥
en: sesame The hearts of sinful men betray the sins committed by them. Those sinful men who conceal their conscious sins from good men meet with destruction.

sa: इत्येष प्रथमः कल्पो व्याख्यातस्ते सुविस्तरात्। असेरुत्पत्तिसंसर्गो यथावद् भरतर्षभ॥
en: I have now told you truly the first portion of your question fully, about the origin and creation of the sword, O foremost of Bharata's family.

sa: राजलोका ह्यतिक्रान्ता यान्न संख्यातुमुत्सहे॥ त्वत्तो बहुतराश्चान्ये भविष्यन्ति पुरंदर।
en: So many kings have gone before you that I venture not to calculate them. In the future also, O Purandara, numberless sovereigns will rise after you.

sa: एवमुक्तस्ततः शर्वः सुरैर्ब्रह्मादिभिस्तथा। आह मां भगवानीशः प्रहसन्निव शंकरः॥
en: Thus addressed by all the gods with the Grandfather Brahman among them, Sharva, otherwise called Isha and Shankara, said these words, as if smiling, to ine.

sa: यावन्त्यस्य शरीरेषु रोमकूपाणि भारत तावन्त्यब्दससहस्राणि स्वर्गे वसति मानवः॥
en: A man by reciting this best of hymns succeeds in living in the celestial region for as many years as there are pores in his body.

sa: रसातलगतश्चापि वराहस्त्रिदशद्विषाम्। खुरैर्विदारयामास मांसमेदोऽस्थिसंचयान्॥
en: On account of those tremendous roars, Vishnu passed by the name of Sanalana.

sa: स्वभावसिद्धमेवैतद् यदिमान् सृजते गुणान्। उर्णनाभिर्यथा सूत्रं विज्ञेयास्तन्तुवद् गुणाः॥
en: Owing to her nature, the Understanding creates all these attributes, as a spider weaves threads. These qualities should be known as the threads the spider weaves.

sa: जटाश्च तेजसा तस्य वैश्वानरशिखोपमाः। प्रज्वलन्त्यः स्म दृश्यन्ते युक्तस्यामिततेजसः॥
en: While the Rishi, gifted with immeasurable energy, sat in Yoga, his mattered locks, on account of his energy, were seen to blaze like flames of fire.

sa: यदूर्ध्वं पादतलयोरवाङ् मूर्ध्नश्च पश्यसि। एतस्मिन्नेव कृत्स्नेयं वर्तते बुद्धिरन्तरे॥
en: What is called the Understanding lives in the interior of what you see above the soles of the feet and below the crown of the heat.

sa: ततोऽमृतं द्यौः प्रववर्ष भास्वती पितामहस्यायतने स्वयम्भुवः। अनाहता दुन्दुभयोऽथ नेदिरे तथा प्रसन्नाव दिशश्चकाशिरे॥
en: Heaven's sky became clear and bright and began to shower ambrosia upon the region of the self-create Grand-father. The celestial keule-druns, though struck by none, began to beat, and all the cardinal points, becoming clear, seemed ablaze with splendour.

sa: यथा तैलक्षयाद् दीपः प्रह्रासमुपगच्छति। तथा कर्मक्षयाद् दैवं प्रहासमुपगच्छति॥
en: As by the diminution of oil in the lamp its light is put out, so does the influence of Destiny, by the abatement of one's acts.

sa: एतन्माहेश्वरं तेजो ज्वरो नाम सुदारुणः॥ नमस्यश्चैव मान्यश्च सर्वप्राणिभिरीश्वरः।
en: This Fever is known to be the dreadful power of Maheshvara. He has authority over all creatures and should, therefore, be respected and adored by all.

sa: एवं युगपदुत्पन्नं दशवर्गमसंशयम्। पञ्चमं विद्धि राजेन्द्र भौतिकं सर्गमर्थवत्॥
en: This aggregate of ten arose, forsooth, at the same time. The fifth creation, O king, is that which has originated, from combinations of the principal elements.

sa: भीष्म उवाच ब्राह्मणानेव सेवेत विद्यावृद्धास्तपस्विनः। श्रुतचारित्रवृत्ताढ्यान् पवित्रं ह्येतदुत्तमम्॥
en: Bhishma said One should always adore Brahmanas respected for learning, devoted to penances, and observant of Vedic injunctions. This, indeed, is a high and sacred duty.

sa: ततः स प्राङ्मुखो विद्वानादित्ये नचिरोदिते। पाणिपादं समादाय विनीतवदुपाविशत्॥
en: Then when the Sun, had not risen long, Shuka sat, with his face turned towards the East, and hands and feet drawn in an humble posture.

sa: भीष्म उवाच हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि येन श्रेयो ह्यवाप्स्यसि। पीत्वामृतमिव प्राज्ञो ज्ञानतृप्तो भविष्यसि॥
en: Bhishma said I shall describe to you that by which you may acquire high merit. Wise as you are, you will be satisfied with the knowledge I will impart to you, like a person gratified with having drunk ambrosia.

sa: न हि मुक्तस्य मुक्तेन ज्ञस्यैकत्वपृथक्त्वयोः। भावाभावसमायोगे जायते वर्णसंकरः॥
en: The contact of one that is liberated with another that has been so, or of Soul with Nature, cannot lead to an intermingling which you fear.

sa: ततो जाम्बूनदीः पात्रीर्वज्राङ्का विमलाः शुभाः। वरान्नपूर्णा विप्रेभ्यः प्रादान्मधुघृतप्लुताः॥ तस्य नित्यं सदाऽऽषाढ्यां माध्यां च बहवो द्विजाः। ईप्सितं भोजनवरं लभन्ते सत्कृतं सदा॥ विशेषतस्तु कार्तिक्यां द्विजेभ्यः सम्प्रयच्छति। शरट्यपाये रत्नानि पौर्णमास्यामिति श्रुतिः॥ सुवर्णं रजतं चैव मणीनथ च मौक्तिकान्॥ वज्रान महाधनांश्चैव वैदूर्याजिनराङ्कवान्। रत्नराशीन् विनिक्षिप्य दक्षिणार्थे स भारत॥ ततः प्राह द्विजश्रेष्ठान् विरूपाक्षो महाबलः। गृह्णीत रत्नान्येतानि यथोत्साहं यथेष्टतः॥
en: After such worship, every one of them looked as effulgent as the moon in the sky. Then bright and polished golden plates, adorned with engravings, and filled with rich viands prepared with clarified butter and honey, were given to those Brahmanas. Every year in the month of Ashada and Magha, a great number of Brahmanas used to receive from he Rakshasa chief, after proper honours, the most excellent food which they desired. Especially, on the day of full moon in the month of Kartika, after the termination of autumn, the king use to give to the Brahmanas much wealth of various kinds, including gold, silver, jewels, gems, pearls, costly diamonds, stones of the lapis lazuli variety, deer-skins, and skins of the Ranku deer. Indeed, O Bharata, throwing a mass of wealth of various sorts for givin

sa: अस्तेनं स्तेन इत्युक्त्वा द्विगुणं पापमाप्नुयात्। त्रिभागं ब्रह्महत्यायाः कन्या प्राप्नोति दुष्यती॥ यस्तु दूषयिता तस्याः शेषं प्राप्नोति पाप्मनः।
en: By calling a person thief who, however, is not a thief, one commits a sin just double the sin of theft. The maiden who spoils her virginity incurs three-fourths of the sin of Brahmanicide, while the man who knows her incurs a sin equal to a fourth part of that of Brahmanicide.

sa: यानि चान्यानि भूतेषु भक्ष्यजातानि कस्यचित्। येषामभुक्तपूर्वाणि तेषामस्मृतिरेव ते॥
en: You have no idea also, O Kashyapa, of every other superior kind of drink and edible that exists among men, for you have never tasted it.

sa: देवतातिथिशेषेण फलमूलाशनो द्विजः। धर्मे चास्य महाराज दृढा बुद्धिरजायत॥
en: Living upon such fruits and roots remained after serving the gods and guests, the mind of that twice-born one, O king, was firmly set upon virtue.

sa: ब्रह्मोवाच बहुधा विभजिष्यामि ब्रह्मवध्यामिमामहम्। शक्रस्याघविमोक्षार्थं चतुर्भागं प्रतीच्छ वै॥
en: Bhishma said I shall divide this sin of Brahmanicide into several parts. For freeing Shakra from her, do you take a fourth portion of that sin.

sa: दमात् तस्य क्रियासिद्धिर्यथावदुपलभ्यते। दमो दानं तथा यज्ञानधीतं चातिवर्तते॥
en: It is from self-control that he acquires the due fruition of his acts. Self-control of surpasses (in merit) charity and sacrifice and study of the Vedas.

sa: अथास्य जम्भतः शक्रस्ततो वज्रमवासृजत्। स वज्रः सुमहातेजा: कालाग्निसदृशोपमः॥ क्षिप्रमेव महाकायं वृत्रं दैत्यमपातयत्।
en: While the Asura was yawning, Indra discharged his thunderbolt at him. Endued with great enrgy and resembling the fire that destroys the creation at the end of the cycle, that thunderbolt overthrew in a moment Vritra of gigantic form.

sa: अथैतद् वचनं प्राहुर्धर्मशास्त्रविदो जनाः। निशम्य भरतश्रेष्ठ बुद्धया परमयुक्तया।॥
en: They who conversant with the scriptures hold this as their opinion, arriving at it, О chief of the Bharatas, with the help of a well-ordered understanding.

sa: ततस्तं रथमास्थाय देवाप्यायित आहवे। वज्रोद्यतकरः शक्रस्तं दैत्यं समवैक्षत॥
en: Then, in that battle, Indra, worshipped of the gods, and armed with the thunderbolt, looked hard at the demon as the latter sat on his car.

sa: बृहस्पतिं च वत्रे स वेदवेदाङ्गभाष्यवित्॥ उपाध्यायं महाराज धर्ममेवानुचिन्तयन्।
en: For all that, Shuka, selected Brihaspati, who was a master of all the Vedas together with their branches and commentaries, for his preceptor, remembering universal practice.

sa: सहस्रजिच्च राजर्षिः प्राणानिष्टान् महायशाः। ब्राह्मणार्थं परित्यज्य गतो लोकाननुत्तमान्॥
en: The royal and highly illustrious sage Shasrajit, having cast off his own dear life for the sake of a Brahmana, ascended to regions of great happiness.

sa: ततस्तस्मिन् महाबाहौ प्रादुर्भूते महात्मनि। भास्करप्रतिमं दिव्यं नाभ्यां पद्ममजायत॥
en: After that great Being. O mighty-armed one, viz., Consciousness originated a highly beautiful lotus effulgent like the Sun out of the navel of the Supreme Being.

sa: शतक्रतुश्च भगवान् विष्णुश्चादितिनन्दनौ। ब्रह्मा रथन्तरं साम ईरयन्ति भवान्तिके॥
en: The powerful Indra and his brother Upendra, the two sons of Aditi, and the Grandfather Brahman, all sang in the presence of Bhava the Rathantara Saman.

sa: स्वभावस्रोतसा वृत्तमुह्यते सततं जगत्॥
en: Formed by the current of Nature, the universe is being ceaselessly carried along.

sa: व्यास उवाच अथ चेद् रोचयेदेतदुह्येत स्रोतसा यथा। उन्मज्जंश्च निमज्जंश्च ज्ञानवान् प्लववान् भवेत्॥
en: Vyasa said If Liberation is sought for, then knowledge should be acquired. For a person who is carried up and down along the stream of Time or life, Knowledge is the raft by which he can reach the shore.

sa: स्त्रिया हि परमो भर्ता दैवतं परमं स्मृतम्। तस्यात्मना तु सदृशमात्मानं परमं ददौ॥
en: It has been said that the husband is the highest object with the wife and the highest god to her. My mother resigned her sacred person to one who came to her in the shape of hcr own husband.

sa: अपक्वमतयो मन्दा न जानन्ति यथातथम्। यथा ह्यशास्त्रकुशलाः सर्वत्रायुक्तिनिष्ठिताः॥
en: Wicked men of unripe understandings, can never know things truly, as persons ignorant of scriptures are unable in all their acts to be guided by reason.

sa: यदा मनसि सा बुद्धिवर्ततेऽन्तरचारिणी। व्यवसायगुणोपेता तदा सम्पद्यते मनः॥
en: When the Understanding, though endued with the quality of certainty, lives in the mind, busied with the internal, even then it is nothing but the mind.

sa: स्थावरेभ्यो विशिष्टानि जङ्गमान्युपधारयेत्। उपपन्नं हि यच्चेष्टा विशिष्येत विशेष्यया॥
en: Mobile creatures should be regarded superior to the immobile. It is reasonable that intelligence which differentiates (all nonintelligent matter), should be considered superior to (non-intelligent) matter.

sa: विषमव्यवहाराश्च विषमाश्चैव वृद्धिषु। लाभेषु विषमाश्चैव ते वै निरयगामिनः॥
en: They who follow improper conduct they who take exorbitant rates of interest, and they who make unduly large profits on sales, have to sink in hell.

sa: न राजानं मृषा गच्छेन्न द्विजातिं कथंचन। न स्त्रियं स्त्रीगुणोपेतां हन्युह्येते मृषा गताः॥
en: One should never appear deceitfully before a king; nor before a Brahmana; nor before his wife when that wife is possessed of every wifely virtue. Those who appear in deceitful guise before these three very soon meet with destruction.

sa: उशना बृहस्पतिश्चैव यदोत्पन्नौ भविष्यतः। तदा प्रवक्ष्यतः शास्त्रं युष्मन्मतिभिरुद्धृतम्॥
en: When Ushanas and Brihaspati will be born, they also will promulgate their respective work on morality and religion, guided by and quoting from this your work.

sa: विष्णोनि:श्वासवातोऽयं यदा वेगसमीरितः। सहसोदीर्यते तात जगत् प्रव्यथते तदा॥
en: This wind is the breath of Vishnu's nostrils. When moved with speed, it begins to blow with great vehemence at which the whole universe becomes agitated.

sa: न त्वस्य रमते बुद्धिराश्रमेषु नराधिप। त्रिषु गार्हस्थ्यमूलेषु मोक्षधर्मानुदर्शिनः॥
en: The mind of the great ascetic, O king, found pleasure in the three modes of life, keeping in view, as he did, the Religion of Liberation.

sa: ततः फलार्थं सर्वस्य भवन्ति ज्यायसे गुणाः। धर्मवृत्त्या च सततं कामार्थाभ्यां न हीयते॥
en: Seeing the misery consequent upon the gratification of the senses, the wise cultivate the virtues of tranquillity and self-control for the purpose of acquiring Liberation. On account of righteous conduct, riches and pleasure can never succeed in afflicting them.

sa: तथा मोहः प्रमादश्च निद्रा तन्द्राप्रबोधिता। कथंचिदभिवर्तन्ते विज्ञेयास्तामसा गुणाः॥
en: Stupefaction of judgement, carelessness, sleep, lethargy, and indolence, from whatever cause these may originate, are to be regarded as the characteristics of the quality of Ignorance.

sa: स्वमेव चार्थं कुर्वाणा यज्ञं चक्रुः पुनर्द्विजाः॥ परिनिष्ठतकर्माणः प्रजानुग्रहकाम्यया।
en: These regenerate men, although all their acts have been done, still perform sacrifices for doing good to all creatures making their own selves as sacrificial offerings.

sa: सर्वेषामेव भूतानां तमस्यपगते यथा। प्रकाशं भवते सर्वं तथेदमुपधार्यताम्॥
en: As all things are seen when the darkness that covers them is removed, so the soul becomes manifest when the darkness that covers it is dispelled.

sa: अशोभतास्य देवस्य माला गात्रे सितप्रभे। जातरूपमयैः पौग्रथिता रत्नभूषिता॥
en: The garland, of the purest white, that was on his body, shone like a wreath of lotuses, of the purest white, adorned with jewels and gems.

sa: स तथेत्युक्त्वा गुरुकुले दीर्घकालं गुरुशुश्रूषणपरोऽवसत्-गौरिव नित्यं गुरुणा धूर्षु नियोज्यमानः शीतोष्णक्षुत्तृष्णादुःखसहः सर्वत्राप्रतिकूलः। तस्य महताकालेन गुरुः परितोषं जगाम॥
en: Veda, having assented to it, remained long in the family of his preceptor, being always mindful to serve him. Like an ox under the burden of his owner, he bore heat and cold, hunger and thirst, without any complaint at all times; and many years thus passed before his preceptor was satisfied.

sa: विष्वग्वाताः सनिर्घाता रूक्षाः शर्करकर्षिणः। ववुरायाति कौन्तेये संग्रामे समुपस्थिते॥
en: Dry winds accompanied by deep sounds and driving pebbles and gravel, began to blow when Kunti's son made his appearance before the commencement of the battle.

sa: आकर्णपूर्णायतसम्प्रयुक्तैः शरैस्तदा संयति तैलधौतैः। अन्योन्यमाच्छादयतां महारथौ मद्राधिपश्चापि युधिष्ठिरश्च॥
en: Those two great car-warriors, viz., Shalya and Yudhishthira, began to cover each other with arrows bathed in oil and shot off bows drawn to their ears.

sa: इहागतेषु वा तेषु निदेशवशवर्तिषु। प्रवर्तिष्यामहे राजन् यथाशास्त्रं निबर्हणम्॥
en: O king, if coming here, they prove themselves docile and obedient to us, we would then try to repress them according to the Shastras (Political science).

sa: उच्चावचानि रूपाणि चकार सुबहूनि च। अणुवृहत्पुनः स्थूलोनादान् मुञ्चन्निवाम्बुदः॥
en: He assumed forms countless and large and small. Sometimes assuming subtle, sometimes a gross and sometimes a huge form, he began to roar like the clouds.

sa: शतं सहस्राण्यश्वानां समारूढानि राघवम्। अन्वयुर्भरतं यान्तं राजपुत्रं यशस्विनम्॥
en: And a hundred thousand horses mounted (by riders) went in the wake of that descendant of Raghu intent upon truth and having his senses under control.

sa: सौमदत्तेः शिरो दृष्ट्वा निहतं तन्महात्मनः। वित्रस्तास्तावका राजन् प्रदुद्रुवुरनेकधा॥
en: Beholding the illustrious son of Somadatta slain and his head roll on the ground, your troops, O king, greatly frightened, began to fly in all directions.

sa: भैमसेनिर्धनुश्छित्त्वा सौमदत्तेर्महात्मनः। ननाद बलवन्नादं विव्याध च शितैः शरैः॥
en: The son of Bhimasena cutting of the bow of the illustrious son of Somadatta, uttered a fierce roar and pierced the latter with numerous sharp arrows.

sa: रुद्रकोधात् प्रयत्नेन सर्वदेवैः सुरक्षितम्॥ तं यज्ञमदहच्छीघ्रं रुद्रकर्मा सभन्ततः।
en: Of terrific deeds, those Reings, urged on by Rudra's anger very soon burnt, that Sacrifice although it was protected with great care by all the gods.

sa: संप्रत्यनाथो विषय इक्ष्वाकूणां महात्मनाम्। राम नाथमिहासाद्य बालान्तकरणं ध्रुवम्॥ राजदोषैविपद्यन्ते प्रजा ह्यविधिपालिताः। असद्धृत्ते हि नृपतावकाले म्रियते जनः॥ यद्वा पुरेष्वयुक्तानि जना जनपदेषु च। कुर्वते न च रक्षास्ति तदा कालकृतं भयम्॥
en: Having attained Rāma as its lord, the kingdom, of the high-souled Ikşvākus, has attained to the condition of one having no master, where during Rāma's regime the death of a boy has been brought about. For being impiously governed by a king, for his sin, the subjects meet with calamities. And a king following evil tracks and not governing the subjects righteously people meet with untimely death. Therefore, when a king does mot suppress the crimes committed by people either in cities, or provinces the fear, of untimely death, comes in.

sa: यः संसदि प्रकृतिभिर्भवेद् युक्त उपासितुम्। वन्यैर्मृगैरुपासीनः सोऽयमास्ते ममाग्रजः॥
en: That elder brother of mine, who (seated) in court should be surrounded by the subjects intent upon paying him homage, is now surrounded by wild deer.

sa: ताः पताका इवोद्धृताः पत्नीनां रुचिरप्रभाः। नानावर्णसुवर्णानां वक्त्रमूलेषु रेजिरे॥
en: At the nether part of the faces of Rāvana's wives, they (the scarf-ends) appeared beauteous like uplifted streamers of exceeding elegance, composed of many-hued golden yarn.

sa: स्नातं कृताछिकं भद्रे कृतकौतुकमङ्गलम्। भीमसेनं भजेथास्त्वं प्रागस्तगमनाद् रवेः॥
en: O blessed lady, when Bhimasena will finished ablutions, twilight prayer and the usual propitiatory rites you will then be adored by him till the sun sets.

sa: तेषां चरणपातेन स्थनेमिस्वनेन च। मम बाणनिपातैश्च हतास्ते शतशोऽसुराः॥
en: By the press of their hoofs and by the thundering noise of the car-wheels and by the discharge of my arrows hundreds of demons fell dead.

sa: यतो वायुर्विनिःसृत्य सूर्यरश्म्याश्रितो महान्। विजृम्भत्यम्बरे तत्र किमाश्चार्यमतः परम्॥
en: What, again, can be more wonderful than this that the powerful Wind, emanating from the Sun, takes refuge in his rays and thence yawns over universe?

sa: स त्वमुज्जास्यमानासु प्रजासु जगतोवर। रावणस्य वधाकाङ्क्षी मानुषेषु मनोऽदधाः॥
en: O lord of the universe, it is for that reason, on beholding the destruction of creatures you went born on earth to slay the Ten-necked demon.

sa: पुष्करेणैवमुक्तस्य पुण्यश्लोकस्य मन्युना। व्यदीर्यतेव हृदयं न चैनं किंचिदब्रवीत्॥
en: Thus spoken to by Pushkara Nala of holy fame felt as if his heart would burst in grief. Neither did he speak a syllable to him.

sa: धिगस्तु राजसं भावमनीशमनवस्थितम् ईश्वरेणापि यद्रागान्मया सीता न रक्षिता॥
en: Fie on this activity, born of (the quality of) passion, which is the source of incompetence and rashness; since although capable, I did not protect Sita.

sa: ततस्तदद्भुतं वाक्यं निशम्यैवामृतोपमम्॥ तस्य प्रसादात् प्राप्ताः स्मो देशमीप्सितमञ्जसा।
en: no Having heard this wonderful words that were sweet as nectar, we soon returned to the place we desired, through the favour of that great Deity.

sa: तेऽपि स्वस्था मुनिगणा एकभावमनुव्रताः॥ नास्मासु दधिरे भावं ब्रह्मभावमनुष्ठिताः।
en: Those ascetics, all of whom were cheerful and filled with devotion and who were all are practising the Brahma-frame of mind, showed no feeling for us.

sa: तैर्हि सम्प्रीयमाणस्त्वं सर्वान् कामानवाप्स्यसि। पाण्डवैनिर्मितां भूमि भुञ्जानो राजसत्तम॥
en: Living in peace with them you will succeed in all your objects enjoying the territories built up by the sons of Pandu, O best among kings,

sa: न शोभार्थाविमौ बाहू न धनुर्भूषणाय मे। नासिराबन्धनार्थाय न शराः स्तम्भहेतवः॥ अमित्रमथनार्थाय सर्वमेतच्चतुष्टयम्। न चाहं कामयेऽत्यर्थं यः स्याच्छत्रुर्मतो मम॥ असिना तीक्ष्णधारेण विद्युच्चलितवर्चसा। प्रगृहीतेन वै शत्रु वज्रिणं वा न कल्पये॥
en: These hands of mine are not intended for enhancing the beauty of my body, this bow is not meant for an ornament only this sword is not for binding woods together with, and these arrows are not for carrying the weight of woods, these four belonging to me are for the use of killing the enemies. Never do I desire that I shall not cut them into pieces with sharp-edged swords, brilliants the lighting, whom I do consider as my enemies, though they be redoubtable as Indra, the wielder of thunder-bolt.

sa: शंसिता पुरुषव्याघ्र त्वन्नः कुलहिते रतः। क्षत्ता चैको महाप्राज्ञो यो नः शंसति सर्वदा॥
en: You, O foremost of men, are ever engaged in encompassing the good of our family. For this reason you always describe to us on the duties of the kings. Endued with great wisdom, Vidura also gives always valuable instruction.

sa: एकाक्षीमेककर्णां च कर्णप्रावरणां तथा। अकर्णां शङ्ककर्णां च मस्तकोच्छ्वासनासिकाम्॥
en: Some had one ear, some one eye, some had big ears some was without ears; some had formidable ears and some had a nose projecting upwards.

sa: व्रीडान्वितः स्वयं यच्च नृपस्त्वां नाभिभाषते। नैतत् किंचिन्नरश्रेष्ठ मन्युरेषोऽपनीयताम्॥
en: The king being abashed, does not himself address you, there is nothing else than this. Do you, Oh best of men, dispel this wretchedness of his.

sa: तां देवीं दीनवदनामदीनां भर्तृतेजसा। रक्षितां स्वेन शीलेन सीतामसितलोचनाम्।।२७
en: And though the countenance of that worshipful one was shorn of all grace, her heart did not loose its loftiness in consequence of her husband's prowess.

sa: एवमस्तु गमिष्यामि वनं वस्तुमहं त्वितः। जटाचीरधरो राज्ञः प्रतिज्ञामनुपालयन्॥
en: Be it what you say; carrying out the promise of the king, I shall repair to the forest from this place wearing bark and matted hair.

sa: नोदितो रामवाक्येन कथयामास सुव्रतः। तस्य देशस्य निखिलमृषिमध्ये महातपाः॥
en: Thus addressed by Rāma, that one of high austerities and excellent vows began in the midst of the saints to describe the opulence of that region.

sa: मा कुलघ्नः कुपुरुषो दुर्मतिः कापथं गमः। मातरं पितरं चैव मा मज्जीः शोकसागरे॥
en: Do not bring about the extermination of your race; do not act like a wicked man of evil intellect and do not follow a wrong course. Do not drown your father and your mother in a sea of grief."

sa: न मामर्हसि धर्मज्ञ वक्तुमेवं कथंचना धर्मपत्नीमभिरतां त्वयि राजीवलोचने॥
en: Kunti said: O virtuous one, you should not say so to me. O lotus eyed one, I am your lawfully wedded wife, ever devoted to you.

sa: भूसंस्कारं राजसंस्कारयोर्ग मभैक्ष्यचर्यां पालनं च प्रजानाम्। विद्याद् राजा सर्वभूतानुकम्पी देहत्यागं चाहवे धर्ममग्न्यम्॥
en: The king, cherishing mercy for all creatures, should consider these as the highest of his duties, viz., reclaiming the land for cultivation and fertilizing it, celebration of great sacrifices for purifying himself, aversion for begging, and protection of subjects.

sa: सान्त्वयित्वा ततस्तां तु बाष्पदूषितलोचनाम्। निवर्तनार्थे धर्मात्मा वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह॥
en: And consoling her whose eyes were stained with tears, that virtuous-souled one spoke to her the following words with a view to prevent her from going.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच श्रुत्वैवं कौरवो राजा वृष्णीनां कदनं महत्। प्रस्थाने मतिमाधाय वाक्यमर्जुनमब्रवीत्॥ काल: पचति भूतानि सर्वाण्येव महामते। कालपाशमहं मन्ये त्वमपि द्रष्टुमर्हसि॥
en: Vaishampayana said, Having heard the particulars of the great destruction of the Vrishnis, the Kaurava king was determined on leaving the world. He addressed Arjuna saying—'O you of great intelligence, it is time which cooks every creature (in is cauldron), I thing that what has taken place is due to the cords of Time (with which he binds us all). You should also see it.'

sa: कृपप्रभृतयश्चैव युयुत्सुं पर्यवारयन्। विवेश गङ्गां कौरव्य उलूपी भुजगात्मजा।॥
en: Kripa and, others stood around Yuyutsu as their centre, Ulupi the daughter of the Naga chief, O you of Kuru's race, entered the waters of Ganga.

sa: तप्तकाञ्चनवर्णाभा रक्ततुङ्गनखी शुभा। सीता नाम वरारोहा वैदेही तनुमध्यमा॥
en: Of the lustre of burnished gold, with her finger nails reddish and projecting, and graceful, that surpassingly lovely wench is named Sītā—the slender-waisted daughter of Videha.

sa: तस्माच्चतुर्णां वंशानां स्थापयित्री सुता मम। इयं सुरसुतप्रख्या सर्वधर्मोपचायिनी॥
en: Slays the sons and grandsons of the man who dose not do him good. Therefore this daughter of mine, who will be perpetuator of four races,

sa: द्विधा कृत्वाऽऽत्मनो देहं भूमौ च गगनेऽपि च। तताप लोकानेकेन द्वितीयेनागमत् स माम्॥
en: He divided himself in two parts. With one portion he was in the sky, and with the other he stood on the Earth before me. With one he hearted the worlds and with another he came to came me.

sa: उपलब्धमिदं द्वारमश्वानामिति चाण्डजः। उक्त्वा गालवमापृच्छ्य जगाम भवनं स्वकम्॥
en: And saying "we see you again” went away. Saying: “The means for obtaining the horses has now been gained," the one born of an egg too

sa: यदि वाप्युपपद्येत पौरुषं नाम कर्हिचित् अन्विष्यमाणं तदपि दैवमेवावतिष्ठते॥
en: Or, if the existence of anything like Exertion (as a resulting factor) be admitted, a little more scrutiny would find that Destiny is at the bottom.

sa: अनेकबाहूदरवक्त्रनेत्रं पश्यामि त्वां सर्वतोऽनन्तरूपम्। नान्तं न मध्यं न पुनस्तवादिं पश्यामि विश्वेश्वर विश्वरूप॥
en: O you of infinite forms, I behold you on every side with innumerable arms, bellies, mouths, and eyes. O Lord of the universe, O you of universal form I do see neither your end, nor middle, nor the beginning.

sa: ततो गच्छेन्नरश्रेष्ठ सोमतीर्थमनुत्तमम्॥ तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् सोमलोकमवाप्नुयात्।
en: O foremost of men, one should then go to the excellent Tirtha, called Soma. O king, bathing there, a man goes to the regions of Soma.

sa: अथाप्येनं पश्यसि यं रथस्थं महाभुजं शालमिव प्रवृद्धम्। संदष्टौष्ठं भृकुटीसंहतभ्रवं वृकोदरो नाम पतिर्ममैषः॥
en: The one, whom you see seated on the car, with long arms and tall as the Shala tree biting his lips, contracting his forehead so as to bring his two eye-brows close together, is my husband by name Vrikodara.

sa: न ह्यतो दुष्करं कर्म किंचिदस्ति सुरोत्तमा यथा विविधवृत्तानामैश्वर्यममराधिप।॥
en: There is nothing, O best of gods, that is more difficult to be done than the acquisition of prosperity, O king of gods, by restless persons.

sa: अवसं त्वयि राजेन्द्र सुदुःखमपराजित। विषेण नागराजस्य दह्यमानो दिवानिशम्॥
en: O foremost of kings, O unconquered one, burning day and night in the poison of the prince of the snakes, I most miserably resided within you.

sa: यस्य क्षतजसंदिग्घौ बाहू चन्दनभूषितौ। अवेक्ष्य करुणं भार्या विलपत्यतिदुःखिता॥
en: Stricken with great sorrow, his wife is weeping bitterly at sight of his arms covered with blood, which, however, formerly used to be smeared with sandal-paste.

sa: स एवमुक्त उपाध्यायेनेष्टं देशं जगाम। अथापर: शिष्योऽस्यैवापोदस्य धौम्यस्योपमन्युर्नाम॥
en: Being thus blessed by his preceptor, Aruni went away to the country where his heart longed to go. The name of another AyudaDhaumya's disciples was Upamanyu.

sa: उषित्वा शर्वरी: श्रीमान् पञ्चाशनगरोत्तमे। समय कौवाग्यस्य सस्मार पुरुषर्षभः॥
en: Having passed fifty nights in the capital, the blessed monarch recollected the time indicated by his grandfather as the hour of his departure from this world.

sa: शठप्रलापाद् विरता विरुद्धपरिवर्जकाः। सौम्यप्रलापिनो नित्यं ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: They who abstain from evil speech or sinful conversation, who avoid disagreeable speeches, and who utter only auspicious and agreeable words, succeed in ascending to Heaven.

sa: एतत् पवित्रं परममेतद् धर्मनिदर्शनम्। एतत् सर्वगुणोपेतं श्रोतव्यं भूतिमिच्छता॥
en: This treatise is purifying. This is the highest indicator as regards duties: this is endues with every merit. One desirous of prosperity should listen to it.

sa: स्वदारनिरता ये च ऋतुकालाभिगामिनः॥ अग्राम्यसुखभोगाश्च ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः।
en: Those men who never know other peoples' wives, who are masters of their senses, and who are given to righteous conduct, succeed in ascending to Heaven.

sa: तथापरेणास्य जहार यन्तुः कायाच्छिरः संहननीयमध्यात्। जधान चाश्वांश्चतुरः सुशीघ्रं तथा भृशं कुपितो भीमसेनः॥
en: With another arrow he cut off the head of Shalya's driver from his trunk the middle of which was encased in mail. Beside himself with anger, Bhimasena next killed without a moment's delay, the four horses of his enemy.

sa: देयं समाप्ते भगवन् किं च पर्वणि पर्वणि। वाचकः कीदृशश्चात्र एष्टव्यस्तद् वदस्व मे॥
en: What should be the gifts that one should make, O holy one, at every Parva or sacred day (during the continuance of the recitation)? What should be the qualifications of the reciter to be engaged? Tell me all this.

sa: हर्षस्थानसहस्राणि भयस्थानशतानि च। दिवसे दिवसे मूढमाविशन्ति च पण्डितम्॥
en: There are thousands of occasions for joy and hundreds of occasions for fear. These affect only him who is ignorant but never him that is wise.

sa: ताभिर्नागलोक उपधूपितेऽथ संभ्रान्तस्तक्षको ऽग्नेस्तेजोभयाद्विषण्ण: कुण्डले गृहीत्वा सहसा भवनान्निष्क्रम्योत्तङ्कमुवाच॥
en: The land of the Nagas was at the point of being burnt down, when Takshaka, taking the ear-rings, hastened to Uttanka, from his palace and said,

sa: तं जाग्रतमदम्भेन भ्रातुराय लक्ष्मणम्। गुहः संतापसंतप्तो राघवं वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: As for the purpose of protecting his brother, Lakṣmaṇa was watching him out of sincere affection, Guha burning in grief addressed that descendant of Raghu, saying.

sa: शूराणां हर्षजननी भीरूणां भयवर्धनी। प्रावर्तत नदी रौद्रा कुरुसृञ्जयसंकुला॥
en: Filling the brave with joy and increasing the fears of the timid, that fierce river flowed the shores of which were filled with Kurus and Srinjayas.

sa: मङ्गलाभिमुखी तस्य सा तदासीन्महाकपेः॥ उपतस्थे विशालाक्षी प्रयता हव्यवाहनम्।
en: And wishing for the welfare of the mighty monkey, that large eyed lady with an intent mind began to pray to that bearer of sacrificial offerings,

sa: प्रववुश्चोत्तमा वाता ननृतुश्चाप्सरोगणाः। प्रजगुर्देवगन्धर्वा वीणाः प्रमुमुचुः स्वरान् ॥
en: And a rare breeze set in, and the multitudes of Apsaras danced; and the celestials and the Gandharvas sang, and the Vinas let out their notes.

sa: अतस्तवाक्षया लोका: स्वशरीरेण भारत। प्राप्तोऽसि भरतश्रेष्ठ दिव्यां गतिमनुत्तमाम्॥
en: Hence, O Bharata, regions of inexhaustible happiness are yours? You have acquired them, O chief of the Bharatas, and yours is a celestial and high end.

sa: स श्राद्धयज्ञो ववृते बहुशो धनदक्षिणः। अनेकधनरत्नौघो युधिष्ठिरमते तदा॥
en: With the approval of Yudhishthira, that, Shraddha-sacrifice became marked by large gifts of wealth and profuse presents of jewels and gems and other kinds of riches.

sa: आयुः सत्त्ववलारोग्यसुखप्रीतिविवर्धनाः। रस्याः स्निग्धाः स्थिरा हृद्या आहाराः सात्त्विकप्रियाः।।
en: The food that increase longevity, energy, strength, health, and well-being and joy, and which is savoury, indigenous, and agreeable, is liked by men of Sattva nature.

sa: कर्शयन्तः शरीरस्थं भूतग्राममचेतसः। मां चैवान्तः शरीरस्थं तान् विद्ध्यासुरनिश्चयान्॥
en: Who has no discernment, but who torture their physical organs, thereby torturing Me who seat within the body, should be known to be of demoniac nature.

sa: अचिन्त्यान्यप्रमेयाणि कुलानि नरपुङ्गव। इक्ष्वाकूणां विदेहानां नैषां तुल्योऽस्ति कश्चन॥
en: O puissant one, the lines of the Ikşvākus and the Vaidehas are exceedingly noble and incomparable. No other race can by any means compare with them.

sa: आज्ञापय महाबाहो सर्वं कर्तास्म्यसंशयम्। तच्छ्रुत्वा भीमसेनस्तु राक्षसं परिषस्वजे॥
en: O mighty-armed hero, command me. I shall certainly be able to perform whatever you will order me to do.” Having heard this, Bhimasena embraced the Rakshasa.

sa: कश्यपस्य मुनेः पुत्रो विनतायाश्च खेचरः। हर्तुं सोममभिप्राप्तो बलवान्कामरूपधृक्॥
en: That the son of the Rishi Kashyapa and Vinata, the great bird, capable of assuming any form at will, is coming to take away the Soma.

sa: ततो वृद्धांश्च बालांश्च स्त्रियश्चादाय पाण्डवः। वीरैर्विहीनान् सर्वांस्ताशक्रप्रस्थे न्यवेशयत्॥
en: Escorting the remainder, with children and old men, and women, the son of Pandu established them, who were reft of heroes, in the city of Indraprastha.

sa: भद्रसालवनं यत्र कालाम्रश्च महाद्रुमः॥ कालाम्रस्तु महाराज नित्यपुष्पफलः शुभः।
en: There is a large forest of Bhadrashva and also a very big tree called Kalamra. O king, this Kalamra is always full of fruits and flowers.

sa: तुल्यरूपगुणोपेतं समवेषं तथैव च॥ एकैकमनुरक्तं च चक्रवाकसमं विभो।
en: O king, they, both possessing equal beauty, both possessing equal virtues, both wearing equal dresses, grow up in great love like a pair of Chakravakas (birds).

sa: सम्प्राक्रुष्टे रुदितस्त्रीकुमारे पराभूते पौरुषे धार्तराष्ट्र। मया कृत्यमिति जानामि शल्य प्रयाहि तस्माद् द्विषतामनीकम्॥
en: Our women and children are weeping and bewailing, the manliness of the sons of Dhritarashtra has been defeated. I know therefore, O Shalya, that it is I who am to fight; proceed therefore against the array of our enemies.

sa: इमास्ता मन्मथवतां हिताः प्रतिहता दिशः। अनुलिप्ता इव घनैर्नष्टग्रहनिशाकराः॥
en: These quarters, enveloped with clouds and having therefore the Moon and stars hidden, are indeed very pleasant to those who are under the influence of Cupid

sa: आवन्त्यौ तु महेष्वासौ महासेनौ महाबलौ। इरावन्तमभिप्रेक्ष्य समेयातां रणोत्कटौ॥
en: The two (royal) brothers from Avanti, both mighty bow-men, possessed of great might, and exceeding effulgence, and both formidable in battle, beholding Iravat, rushed at him.

sa: अहं तु हृतदारश्च राज्याच्च महतश्च्युतः। नदीकूलमिव क्लिन्नमवसीदामि लक्ष्मण॥
en: And I am, O Laksmana, waning every day like to the banks of a river, being separated from my spouse and deprived of my vast kingdom.

sa: तौ तु सुप्तौ महाराज श्रमशोकसमन्वितौ। महार्हशयनोपेतौ भूमावेव ह्यनाथवत्॥
en: Indeed, O king, they, who had always slept on costly beds, not slept, like helpless persons, on the bare ground, worn out with fatigue and gricf.

sa: हृष्टनारीनरयुतं रामवेश्म तदा बभौ। यथा मत्तद्विजगणं प्रफुल्लनलिनं सरः॥
en: At that time Răma's residence was filled with joyous men and women; and it was like to a lake containing lotuses and graced with maddened birds.

sa: तमागतमभिप्रेक्ष्य हित्वा राजासनं नृपः। पप्रच्छ स्वमतं तस्मै कृतमित्यभिवेदयत्॥
en: Seeing him come, the king rising up from his royal seat, asked Vasiştha whether his intention had been carried out, whereupon Vasiştha answered that it had.

sa: देवानां मानुषाणां च सर्वभूतसुखावहः। त्रिभिर्विक्रमणैर्देव त्रयो लोकास्त्वया हृताः॥
en: O god, you are the cause of happiness of both the celestials and the human beings. By your three steps you covered all the three worlds.

sa: ब्रह्म वेदाश्च वेद्यं च त्वया सृष्टं महाद्युते। शिरस्ते गगनं देव नेत्रे शशिदिवाकरौ॥
en: O greatly effulgent one, Brahma himself, the Vedas and all things that are capable of being known, have been all created by you. O lord, the sky is your head and the sun and the moon are your eyes.

sa: सर्वे कौरवसैन्यस्य सपुत्रामात्यसैनिकाः। संविभक्ता हि मात्राभिर्भोगैरपि च सर्वशः॥
en: All the officers of the Kuru army with their sons and relatives have been honoured by Duryodhana with the presentation of wealth according to proper divisions.

sa: चतुर्भिनिजघानाश्वान् पत्रिभिः कृतवर्मणः। विव्याध गौतमं चापि षड्भिर्भल्लैः सुतेजनैः॥
en: The great car-warrior Yudhishthira then quickly killed the four horses of Kritavarman with four arrows and struck the son of Gotama with six broad-headed powerful arrows.

sa: तमुवाचाऽव्ययो देवो वरदोऽस्मीति खेचरम्। स वने तव तिष्ठेयमुपरीत्यन्तरिक्षगः॥
en: The undeteriorating Deity said to the great bird, “I am willing to grant you a boon." Thereupon the bird said, "I want to stay above you.”

sa: समेत्य ददृशुर्भूमौ पतितं रणमूर्धनि। प्रतिजज्ञे दृढक्रोधो द्रौणिर्यत्र महारथः॥
en: They saw King Duryodhana lying on the ground, his thighs broken and his body covered with blood. The great car-warrior, fearfully angry son of Drona vowed.

sa: आकाशे दुन्दुभीनां च बभूव तुमुलः स्वनः। उदतिष्ठन्महाघोषः पुष्पवृष्टिभिरावृतः॥
en: The sounds of drums of drums rose in the sky and made a great noise; and the whole place was covered with the showers of flowers.

sa: अथवैनं निहत्याजौ शेषेणापि समाहताः। प्राप्नुयाम ततः स्वर्ग ज्ञातित्राणपरायणाः॥
en: Desirous as we are of protecting our relatives we shall either kill him, in battle or being ourselves killed by him we shall ascend to heaven.

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा विष्णुवचनं ब्रह्मा लोकगुरुः प्रभुः। लोकान्संतानकानाम यास्यन्तीमे समागताः॥
en: Hearing the words of Vişņu, the lord Brahma, father of all creatures, said:-All these people who have come here shall go to the region named Santanaka.

sa: समाप्तशिक्षो भीमस्तु द्युमत्सेनसमो बले। पराक्रमेण सम्पन्नो भ्रातृणामचरद् वशे॥
en: At the end of his education (in arms), he became in strength equal to Duymutsena. He remained in harmony with his brothers, becoming great in prowess.
