sa: तस्मिन्प्रतिगते विप्रे छद्मनोपेत्य तक्षकः। तं नृपं नृपतिश्रेष्ठं पितरं धार्मिकं तव॥ प्रासादस्थं यत्तमपि दग्धवान्विषवह्निना। ततस्त्वं पुरुषव्याघ्र विजयायाभिषेचितः॥
en: When the Brahman went back, Takshaka went in disguise to that best of kings, your virtuous father, who was then staying with all precautions in his palace; and he burnt him with the fire of his poison. After this (most lamentable event,) you, O best of kings, were installed on the throne.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच कुरुराजे हि रङ्गस्ये भीमे च बलिनां वरे। पक्षपातकृतस्नेहः स द्विधेवाभवज्जनः॥।॥
en: Vaishampayana said : On the appearance of the Kuru prince (Duryodhana) and the foremost of all strong men Bhima, the spectators were divided into two parties by their partiality swayed by the love (towards each of the contending heroes).

sa: त्वमन्तः सर्वभूतानां गूढश्चरसि पावक। त्वामेकमाहुः कवयस यस्त्वामाहुस्त्रिविधं पुनः॥
en: O purifier, you move invisible in the body of every creature. The learned have said that you are a unit and again you possess triple nature.

sa: वव्राज तरसा वेगाद्वायुं स्पर्धन्महाजवः। तं व्रजन्तं खगश्रेष्ठं वज्रेणेन्द्रोऽभ्यताडयत्॥
en: Mocking the wind with fleetness, he then swiftly proceeded on his way and when the great bird was thus going away, Indra hurled at him thunder-bolt.

sa: भौमेन प्राविशद् भूमि पार्वतेनासृजद् गिरीन्। अन्तर्धानेन चास्त्रेण पुनरन्तर्हितोऽभवत्॥
en: He created land by the Bhima weapon and by the Parvata weapon he created the mountains. He made all this to disappear by the Antardhana weapon.

sa: मरुतां तु गणाद्विद्धि संजातमरिमर्दनम्। विराटं नाम राजानं परराष्ट्रप्रतापनम्॥
en: That chastiser of foes, was also born of the same celestials. The king Virata, the conqueror of other kingdoms, was also born of the same celestials.

sa: तत्राहं तत् करिष्यामि यदर्थमिदमावृतम्। फलमेतस्य तपसः कथयध्वं दिवौकसः॥
en: O dwellers of heaven, tell me why these regions are shut against me. I will do that which will give me the fruit of my asceticism.

sa: पौरवं युधि निर्जित्य दस्यून् पर्वतवासिनः। गणानुत्सवसंकेतानजयत् सप्त पाण्डवः॥
en: Having vanquished the Puru king, and also the robber tribes of the mountains, the son of Pandu brought under his sway the seven tribes, called Utsavasanketa.

sa: अल्पापराधे काकुत्स्थ द्विजाभ्यां शाप ईदृशः। महानृगस्य राजर्षेर्यमदण्ड इवापरः॥
en: "O Kakutstha, it is for a very simple folly that the two Brāhmaṇas imprecated that curse upon the king Nrga, dreadful as the rod of Yama.

sa: भरतानां महज्जन्म शृण्वतामनसूयताम्। नास्ति व्याधिभयं तेषां परलोकभयं कुतः॥
en: He who hears the history of the Bharata race without being fault-finding, can have no fear from diseases, let alone the fear of the other world.

sa: ततस्तप्तुमथारेभे पत्यर्थमसुखा ततः। तोषयामास तपसा सा किलोग्रेण शंकरम्॥
en: Thereupon, she began with sorrowful heart to perform austere penances with the object of getting a husband. And she gratified Shankara (Shiva) by her severe ascetic.

sa: आदित्य इव मध्याह्ने क्रोधदीप्तवपुर्बभौ। अङ्गारवर्षं मुञ्चन्ती मुहुर्बालधितो महत्॥
en: Blazing in anger, she soon become fearful to look at as the sun at mid day. She began incessantly to shower burning coals from her tail.

sa: आदित्या वसवो रुद्रा मरुतश्चाश्विनावपि। विश्वेदेवाश्च साध्याश्च पितरश्च मनोजवाः॥
en: The Adityas, the Vasus, the Rudras, the Marutas, the Ashvinis, the Vishvadevas, the Sadhyas, the Pitris, all possessing the speed of mind, (wait upon the Grandsire).

sa: पुंनाम्नो नरकात् पुत्रस्त्रायते पितरं श्रुतिः। तस्मादपत्यसंताने यतस्व ब्रह्मसत्तम।॥
en: It is said in Smriti, that the son rescues the father from the hell, called Put, O best of Brahmanas, therefore, try to be get children.

sa: अर्चिताश्च नरैः पौरैः पाण्डवा भरतर्षभ। जग्मुरावसथं पश्चात् पुरोचनपुरस्सराः॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, thus adored by the citizens, the Pandavas went to their house with Purochana walking at the head (of the possession).

sa: ते तथोक्त्वा महात्मानो दिवमारुरुहुस्तदा। शत्रुघ्नोऽपि महातेजास्तां सेनां समुपानयत्॥
en: The high-souled celestials having ascended the welkin saying this, the highly effulgent Śatrughna brought the soldiers there, that were encamped on the banks of the Gangā.

sa: यान्कीर्तयित्वा मनुजः सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते। ब्रह्मणो हृदयं भित्त्वा निःसृतौ भगवान्भृगुः॥ भृगोः पुत्रः कविर्विद्वाञ्छुक्रः कविसुतो ग्रहः। त्रैलोक्यप्राणयात्रार्थं वर्षावर्षे भयाभये। स्वयंभुवा नियुक्तः सम्भुवनं परिधावति॥ योगाचार्यो महाबुद्धिर्दैत्यानामभवद्गुरुः। सुराणां चापि मेधावी ब्रह्मचारी यतव्रतः॥
en: Which narration cleanses men of all their sins. The illustrious Bhrigu sprang forth, ripping open the breast of Brahma. Bhrigu's son was the learned Shukra, a poet himself and the son of a poet. He, being commanded by the Self-created (Brahma) to pour rain and withhold it and to dispense and remit calamities, became a planet and he (still) traverses the sky in order to sustain the lives of all creatures Yoga philosophy, that greatly intelligent man, that wise and self-controlled Brahmachari became the preceptor of the Devas and the Danavas.

sa: सुप्रीताश्चाब्रुवरामं देवाः सत्यपराक्रमम्। सुरकार्यमिदं देव सुकृतं ते महामते।७।।
en: And being greatly delighted, the celestials said to Rama, having truth for his prowess:-0 you of a great mind, you have nicely performed this god-like work.

sa: अहनी युयुधे द्वे तु कर्ण: परबलार्दनः। शल्योऽर्धदिवसं चैव गदायुद्धमतःपरम्॥ तस्यैव दिवसस्यान्तं द्रौणिहार्दिक्यगौतमाः॥
en: The destroyer of enemy's soldiers, Karna, fought for two days; Shalya for half a day and for a half a day then lasted the club-fight of Duryodhana and Bhima. At the close of that day, Ashvathama, Kritavarma and Kripa.

sa: नटा वैतालिकास्तत्र नर्तकाः सूतमागधाः। नियोधकाच देशेभ्यः समेष्यन्ति महावलाः॥
en: There will come in that Svaimvara) from many countries, the singers of king's penegeries, the dancers, the reciters of Puranas, the heralds and the powerful athletes.

sa: अनोपनिषदं पुण्यां कृष्णद्वैपायनोऽब्रवीत्। विद्वद्भिः कथ्यते लोके पुराणे कविसत्तमैः॥
en: Great Dvaipayana composed a holy Upanishad on these facts; and it has been published to the world by the learned and sacred bards in the Puranas.

sa: बभूवोद्दालको नाम महर्षिरिति नः श्रुतम्॥ श्वेतकेतुरिति ख्यातः पुत्रस्तस्याभवन्मुनिः।
en: We have heard that there was a great Rishi, named Uddalaka. He had a son, known by the name of Svetaketu, who was also a Rishi.

sa: दग्धस्यास्त्राग्निना पूर्वं कृष्णात् संजीवनं पुनः। चर्यायां हयमुत्सृष्टं पाण्डवस्यानुगच्छतः॥
en: Who was burnt by the weapon of Ashvathama and therefore almost dead, but he was revived by Krishna; Arjuna's journey with the sacrificial horse let loose.

sa: सुते सोमसहस्रे तु सोमार्कसमतेजसम्। सुतसोमं महेष्वासं सुषुवे भीमसेनतः॥
en: Because the child that Draupadi bore to Bhimsena was born after Bhima had performed one thousand Soma sacrifices, he should be called the great bow-man Sutasoma.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच कृतविद्ये कचे प्राप्ते हृष्टरूपा दिवौकसः। कचादधीत्य तां विद्यां कृतार्था भरतर्षभ।॥
en: Vaishampayana said: O best of the Bharata race, the dwellers of heaven were exceedingly glad to get back Kacha who had learnt the knowledge (of Sanjivini). The celestial then learnt the Sanjivini from Kacha and considered their object achieved.

sa: धर्मराजायुषोर्धेन रुरोर्भार्या प्रमद्वरा। समुत्तिष्ठतु कल्याणी मृतैवं यदि मन्यसे॥
en: "O king Dharma, if it please you, let the beautiful bride of Ruru, Pramadvara, who is dead, rise up endued with a half of Ruru's life.”

sa: पौरवेणाथ वयसा राजा यौवनमास्थितः। यायातेनापि वयसा राज्यं पूरुरकारयत्॥
en: The king again became a young man with the youth of Puru; and Puru with the old age of his father upon him ruled the kingdom.

sa: कच्चित् सहस्रैर्मूर्खाणामेकं क्रीणासि पण्डितम्। पण्डितो ह्यर्थकृच्छ्रेषु कुर्यान्निःश्रेयसं परम्॥
en: Do you purchase one single learned inan in exchanges of one thousand ignorant men? The learned man confers the greatest good at the time of distress.

sa: ततो हि देवा ऋषिपन्नगाश्च प्रपूजिरे ह्यप्सरसश्च सर्वाः स्त्यक्त्वा भयं सर्प इव प्रशान्तः॥
en: There upon chanting the glories of Satrughna, the celestials, Rşis, Pannagas, Apsarās, said “O son of Dasaratha, it is really fortunate, that you, renouncing fear, have acquired victory, and that the Rākṣasa Lavaņa has been vanquished like a serpent."

sa: कालेयानां तु ये पुत्रास्तेषामष्टौ नराधिपाः। जज्ञिरे राजशार्दूल शार्दूलसमविक्रमाः॥
en: O best of kings, the eight sons of the Asura Kaleyas were all born on earth and they all became great kings as powerful as tigers.

sa: तुतोष च यथावच्च पूजां प्राप्य युधिष्ठिरात्। सोऽर्चितः पाण्डवैः सर्वैर्महर्षिर्वेदपारगः। धर्मकामार्थसंयुक्तं पप्रच्छेदं युधिष्ठिरम्॥
en: He (Narada) was gratified by receiving the worship from Yudhishthira in proper form. Having been thus worshipped by all the Pandavas, the great Rishi, learned in the Vedas, spoke to Yudhishthira the following words on Dharma, Artha and Kama.

sa: सात्यकिः सत्यसन्धश्च योऽसौ वृष्णिकुलोद्वहः। पक्षात्स जज्ञे मरुतां देवानामरिमर्दनः॥
en: He who was known as Satyaki, the upholder of the pride of Vrishnis and the chastiser of foes, was born of the portion of celestial Marutas.

sa: कच्चिन्मूलं दृढं कृत्वा परान् यासि विशाम्पते। तांश्च विक्रमसे जेतुं जित्वा च परिरक्षसि॥
en: O king, do you march against your enemy, after first strengthening your own kingdom? Having marched against them, do you try your best to obtain victory over them? Having conquered them with your might do (afterwards) you protect them?

sa: भीमसेनसहायश्च रथानामयुतं च सः। अर्जुनः समरे प्राच्यान् सर्वानेकरथोऽजयत्॥
en: The third of the Pandava princes, assisted by Bhima, on only one single car, subjugated all the kings of the East backed by ten thousand cars.

sa: तत्र तस्याः समभवद्गर्भो ज्वलनसंनिभः। अतीव तेजसा युक्तो वैश्वानरसमद्युतिः॥
en: Thereupon she became quick with child and the embryo was like fire. It was greatly effulgent and was as resplendent as the god of fire himself.

sa: तां नदीमाकुलावा सर्वत्रानुसरन्नृपः। आगतः सप्रजो रामस्तं देशं रघुनन्दनः॥
en: And having crossing that river of rising waves to some extent, Răma, with his followers arrived at the place where he should give up his person.

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा वासुदेवस्य तथा चक्रुर्जनाधिप॥
en: O king, having heard these words of Vasudeva, they did as he directed.

sa: ब्रह्मोवाच यदर्थमभिसंप्राप्ता मत्सकाशं वसुंधरे। तदर्थं संनियोक्ष्यामि सर्वानेव दिवौकसः॥
en: Brahma said: O Vasundhara (the holder of wealth,) I shall appoint all the dwellers of heaven in the work for which you have come to me.

sa: सौतिरुवाच संप्रहृष्टात्स्ततो नागा जलधाराप्लुतास्तदा। सुपर्णेनोह्यमानास्ते जग्मुस्तं द्वीपमाशु वै॥
en: Sauti said: The Nagas became exceedingly glad on being wetted by the great shower; and carried by the bird (Garuda) they soon arrived at the island.

sa: वक्ता प्रगल्भो मेधावी स्मृतिमान् नयवित् कविः। परापरविभागज्ञः प्रमाणकृतनिश्चयः॥
en: Who was eloquent, resolute, intelligent, learned, possessor of powerful memory, learned in the science of morality and politics, proficient in distinguishing inferior things from the superior.

sa: सान्त्वयामास भगवान्वधूं ब्रह्मा पितामहः। अश्रुबिन्दूद्भवा तस्याः प्रावर्तत महानदी॥
en: The Grandfather of all beings, noble Brahma consoled his own daughter-in-law (Puloma) and a great river was formed from the tears thai fell from her eyes.

sa: अथ चिन्तां समापेदे पुनः कौरवन्दन। अम्भस्यस्या निमज्जेयमिति दुःखसमन्वितः॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, seeing this, the sorrowful Rishi began to ponder and thought that he would certainly be killed if he fell into its waters.

sa: तेजस्विनः सोमसुतो विशोका विगतज्वराः। पराशरः पर्वतश्च तथा सावर्णिगालवौ॥
en: All that are energetic, without grief of any kind, and without any fever (of anxiety), all performers of performers of Soma sacrifice. Parashara, Parvata, Savarni, Galava.

sa: जुह्वत्स्वृत्विक्ष्वथ तदा सर्पसत्रे महाक्रतौ। अहयः प्रापतस्तत्र घोराः प्राणिभयावहाः॥
en: When the Ritvijas began to offer ghee in the fire in that Snake-sacrifice, fearful snakes, striking fear into every creature, began to fall into its fire.

sa: जामदग्न्येन रामेण सर्वास्त्रविदुषां वरः। योऽयुध्यत महातेजा भार्गवेण महात्मना॥
en: That best of men, being learned in the science of arms and endued with great energy, fought with the illustrious (Parshu) Rama, the son of Jamadagni.

sa: आविब्रुवन्ती किंचित् सा राजानं साश्रुलोचना। अचिरादेव सम्प्राप्ता काव्यस्योशनसोऽन्तिकम्॥
en: She did not speak a word to the king, but she, with her eyes full of tears, soon reached her father, Ushanas, the son of Kavi.

sa: भूयश्चाद्भुतवीर्यौजा धर्ममेवानुचिन्तयन्। किं हितं सर्वलोकानां भवेदिति मनो दधे॥
en: Reflecting upon virtue and righteousness, that king of wonderful energy and prowess set his heart to find out what should be beneficial to all his people.

sa: योजनार्धमथो गत्वा कृष्णः परपुरंजयः। युधिष्ठिरं समामत्र्य निवर्तस्वेति भारत।॥
en: O Descendant of Bharata, that vanquisher of hostile cities, Krishna, bade Yudhishthira farewell and requested him to return, when he had gone about half a Yojana.

sa: स सर्वान्पार्थिवाञ्जित्वा सर्वांश्च महतोगणान्। आजहारार्जुनो राज्ञो राजसूयं महाक्रतुम्॥
en: He defeated all the neighbouring potentates and chief tribes and thus accomplished all that was necessary for the king (Yudhishthira) to perform the great Rajasuya sacrifice.

sa: त्वामष्टधा कल्पयित्वा यज्ञवाहमकल्पयन्। त्वया विश्वमिदं सृष्टं वदन्ति परमर्षयः॥
en: The wise perform their sacrifices before you and they consider you as having eight (murtis). The great Rishis say that this universe is erected by you.

sa: गजो गजेनेव मया दुरात्मा योद्धं समाकाङ्क्षति सूतपुत्रः। तमेव मां प्रापय राजपुत्र दुर्योधनापाश्रयजातदर्पम्॥
en: The wicked-souled son of the charioteer (Karna) wishes to fight with me as an elephant does with another (elephant). Do you take me to him, O prince, who has grown insolent for the protection afforded to him by Duryodhana.

sa: अश्वैर्विपरिधावद्भिः शरच्छन्नैर्विशाम्पते। तत्र तत्र वृतो मार्गो विकर्षद्भिर्हतान् बहून्॥
en: The horses struck with arrows, dragging after them as they ran a large number of killed warriors the passage in the battle-field was entirely blocked up.

sa: अनागतं हि बुध्येत यच्च कार्यं पुरः स्थितम्। न तु बुद्धिक्षयात् किंचिदतिक्रामेत् प्रयोजनम्॥
en: You should consider the future acts as already arrived. Else on account of the loss of reason, you may overlook an important point (in accomplishing the act). He who desires prosperity, should always exert himself with energy and prudence.

sa: सुदुष्करमिदं पुत्रि तव चारित्रलक्षणम्। कृतं यत्तेऽन्यनारीणां यशो ह्यभिभविष्यति॥
en: What you have performed, O daughter, to establish the purity of your character, is hard to perform. What you have done, shall glorify all other females.

sa: विनाशुमुपयास्यन्ति मच्छरौघनिपीडिताः। ये त्वेते रथिनो राजन् दृश्यन्ते काञ्चनध्वजाः॥
en: They shall today meet with their destruction, being sorely afflicted by my arrowy showers. O king, those other warrior owning golden standards, whom you can see.

sa: धनंजयरथं हित्वा राधेयं प्रत्युदीयतुः। राधेयोऽपि महाराज शरवर्ष समुत्सृजन्॥
en: Leaving the car of Dhananjaya, advanced against the son of Radha. (There upon) O monarch, the son of Radha too, began to discharge showers of arrows.

sa: जघान सुबहूंस्तेषां संरब्धः कुरुसत्तमः। ततस्ते शरणं जग्मुर्देवव्रतमिमं भयात्॥
en: That best one among the race of the Kurus, wrathful, killed many among them (enemies); them they out of fear sought the protection of this Devavrata.

sa: अन्यथा झुषिताः पूर्वं परद्रव्याभिहारिणः। अशक्ताः किञ्चिदादातुं द्रव्यं गोमायुयन्त्रिताः॥
en: Robbing other people's property, they had long enjoyed their sports. Now, however, being governed by the jackal, they were unable to take anything belonging to others.

sa: आख्याता गृध्रराजेन समुत्प्लुत्य प्लवङ्गमाः। संगताः प्रीतिसंयुक्ता विनेदुः सिंहविक्रमाः॥
en: Having heard all this related to them by the vulture-king, the monkeys possessing the strength of lions, filled with delight, bounded and set up a roar.

sa: चन्दने मलपङ्के च भोजनेऽभोजने समाः। समं येषां दुकूलं च तथा क्षौमाजिनानि च॥
en: They cast impartial looks on sandal paste and filth or dirt, on what is food and what is not food. They see with an equal eye their brown dresses of coarse cloth and fabrics of silk and animal skins.

sa: निहताः शेरते स्मान्ये बीभत्सोर्निशितैः शरैः। गजपृष्ठगता म्लेच्छा नानाविकृतदर्शनाः॥
en: Others slain by the whetted arrows of Vibhatsu, lay prostrate on the field of battle. Numerous Mlechhas, riding on the backs of elephants, of ugly appearances.

sa: दशग्रीवो महातेजा राजा वैश्रवणानुजः। भीमकर्मा महात्मा हि रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः॥ तस्यासीद्वीर्यवान्पुत्रो रावणप्रतिमो बले। वृद्धसेवी श्रुतिधरः सर्वस्त्रविदुषां वरः॥
en: The highly powerful .king, Vaisravana's younger brother of dreadful deeds, the highsouled Rävaņa, is the sovereign of the Rāks asas. This one is his mighty son, like to Rāvaņa himself in strength. He serve the aged, is of wide celebrity and is the prime of those versed in all branches of knowledge.

sa: श्वसनेन च संयोगादतिवेगो महाबलाः। कालाग्निरिव जज्वाल प्रावर्धत हुताशनः॥
en: And assisted by the wind, that highly powerful and vehement one (Fire) flaimed up, like fire at the wreck of all, and the fire attained energy.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा भीमसेनस्तु कनिष्ठैर्धातृभिः सह। मृगमध्ये यथा सिंहो मुहुर्मुहुरुदैक्षत॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having said this Bhima with his younger brothers repeatedly cast his angry glances around as a lion does towards a herd of small animals.

sa: कक्षसेनश्च राजर्षिर्वसिष्ठाय महात्मने। न्यासं यथावत् संन्यस्य जगाम सुमहायशाः॥
en: The illustrious Royal Sage Kakshasena went to the celestial region by duly making over to the great Vasishtha the wealth which he had deposited with him.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच स्पृश मां पाणिना भूयः परिष्वज च पाण्डव। जीवामीवातिसंस्पर्शात् तव राजीवलोचन॥
en: Dhritarashtra said Do you, again, touch me, O son of Pandu, with your hand, and do you embrace me. O you having eyes like lotus petals, I am restored to my senses through the auspicious touch of your hand.

sa: पुरेव मे चारुदतीमनिन्दितां दिशन्ति सीतां यदि नाद्य मैथिलीम्। सदेवगन्धर्वमनुष्यपन्नगं जगत् सशैलं परिवर्तयाम्यहम्॥
en: I shall bring about a mighty revolution in the world containing the celestials Gandharvas, human beings, Pannagas and the mountains, if I do not get back, in her pristine beauty, my Sītā, the daughter of the King of Mithilā.

sa: मङ्गलानि च सर्वाणि कौमाराणि त्रयोदश। जातकर्मादिकास्तस्य क्रियाश्चक्रे महामुनिः॥
en: All the thirteen auspicious rites of childhood such as the birth and other ceremonies were all performed by the great Rishi in respect of that child.

sa: नाग्निहोत्राण्यहूयन्त सूर्यश्चान्तरधीयत।। व्यसृजन् कवलान् नागा गावो वत्सान्न पाययन्॥
en: And oblations to the fire had not been offered; and the Sun set; and elephants forsook their forage; and the kine did not suckle their calves.

sa: चुकोप बलवद्वीरश्चिक्षेपास्य शिलाशितान्। तान् प्रत्यगृह्णात् कर्णोऽपि प्रतीपं प्रापयच्छरान्॥
en: Became inflamed with wrath; and that mighty hero discharged at him numerous shafts whetted on stone. Karna received all those shafts and sped many in return.

sa: स्मितहास्यान्तरयुतं गुणवन्मधुरं हितम्। वैदेह्या वाक्यमतुलं कदा श्रोष्यामि लक्ष्मण॥
en: When shall I hear again O Lakṣmaṇa, the sweet incomparable and auspicious accents of Vaidehī, intervened by smiles and couched in an elegant and easy style?

sa: भीष्म उवाच शृणु राजन् यथा राजा वीतहव्यो महायशाः। राजर्षिर्दुर्लभं प्राप्तो ब्राह्मण्यं लोकसत्कृतम्॥
en: Bhishma said Hear, O king, how the highly illustrious royal sage Vitahavya succeeded formerly in acquiring the dignity of a Brahmana that is so difficult to attain and that is held in such high esteem by all the world.

sa: आकाशदेशमासाद्य विमुक्तं कृष्णवर्मना। उत्स्रष्टुकामं तं नागः पुन: कर्कोटकोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Having approached an open ground, free from the fire, Nala was desirous of leaving him, whereupon the Naga (king of the snakes) again said to him:

sa: उत्पतन्तं तु वेगेन जग्राहैनं मनस्विनम्। भीष्म एव महाबाहुर्महासेनमिवेश्वरः॥
en: As the strong-minded (hero) was about to jump up with great impetuosity, the mighty armed Bhishma caught him (by the hand), as if Mahadeva seized Mahasena.

sa: एतस्मात् कारणाद् राजन् पाणिग्रहणमिष्यते। यदाप्नोति पतिर्भार्यामिहलोके परत्र च॥
en: O king, for all these reasons, marriage exists (in this world). The husband enjoys the company of his wife, both here in this world and hereafter.

sa: संजय उवाच कर्णभीमौ महाराज पराक्रान्तौ महाबलौ। बाणवर्षाण्यसृजतां वृष्टिमन्ताविवाम्बुदौ॥
en: Sanjaya said O mighty monarch, then the two powerful heroes Karna and Bhima began to pour showers of arrows, like two rain clouds pouring their contents.

sa: तान् पाण्डवाः प्रत्यगृहंस्त्वरिताः पुत्रगृद्धिनः। पञ्चाला: केकया मत्स्याः सृञ्जयाचोद्यतायुधाः॥
en: Prompted by their affection for their sons, the Pandavas quickly encountered them (assailants), being followed by the Panchalas, Kaikayas, Matsyas and Srinjayas, with their arms uplifted.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा महाबाहुर्लक्ष्मणं पुरुषर्भम्॥ उवाच रामो धर्मात्मा गिरिं प्रस्रवणाकुलम्।
en: Having spoken these words to Lakşmaņa, the best of men, the virtuous-souled Rāma, of mighty arms, addressed the mountain in front of him containing many fountains.

sa: शैनेयेऽधिष्ठिते राजन् विरथे कृतवर्मणि॥ दुर्योधनबलं सर्वं पुनरासीत् पराङ्मुखम्।
en: After Kritavarman had been made carless and the grandson of Shini had grown powerful on the field, the entire army of Duryodhana took to their heels.

sa: सौमित्रेश्चापनिर्घोषं श्रुत्वा प्रतिभयं तदा। विसिष्मिये महातेजा राक्षसेन्द्रात्मजो बली॥
en: Hearing the dreadful twang of the bow of Sumitrā's son , the exceedingly energetic and powerful son of the lord of Rākşasas was struck with surprise.

sa: किं पुनर्धार्तराष्ट्रस्य बलमेतत् सुदुर्बलम्। अर्जुनस्त्वेष वार्ष्णेय पीडितो बहुभिर्युधि॥
en: What to speak of this weak host of the sons Dhritarashtra? But, O you of Vrishni's race, Arjuna is sorely pressed by numerous odds in battle.

sa: ता बाष्पपरिपूर्णाक्ष्यो भर्तृशोकपराजिताः। करिण्य इव नर्दन्त्यः केरेण्वो हतयूथपाः॥
en: With eyes full of tears and overwhelmed with the grief of their husband they began to move about like she-elephants without the lord of their herd.

sa: गार्हस्थ्येऽप्यथवा बाल्ये यौवने स्थविरेऽपि वा। यथा फलं समश्याति तथा त्वं कथयस्व मे॥
en: Is it by practicing charity when leading the domestic life or in boyhood or in youth or in the old age (that one goes to Indra's abode)? Tell me the respective merits of charity in different stages of life.

sa: अथैनं दशभिर्बाणैस्तोत्रैरिव महाद्विपम्। आजघान रणे वीरं स्मयन्निव महारथः॥
en: Then the mighty car-warrior Bhima, as if smiling, struck Duryodhana with ten shafts, in that battle, like and elephants-rider piercing the huge animal with the hook.

sa: ईश्वरः सर्वभूतानां हृद्देशेऽर्जुन तिष्ठति। भ्रामयन् सर्वभूतानि यन्त्रारूढानि मायया॥
en: The Lord, O Arjuna, as if mounted on a machine, sits in the heart of all beings, turning them as He pleases by His illusive powers.

sa: तस्य तेनावकीर्णस्य शरजालेन सर्वतः। मोहात् पपात गाण्डीवमावापश्च करादपि।॥
en: Overwhelmed by that dense cloud of arrows, Arjuna became stupefied. The bow, Gandiva, fell down from his relaxed grip and his leathern hence also dropped down.

sa: इन्द्र उवाच न मया भगवॅल्लोभाद्भुतं पुष्करमद्य वै धर्मांस्तु श्रोतुकामेन हतं न क्रोद्भुमर्हसि॥
en: Indra said O holy one, I did not remove your stalks, moved by cupidity. Indeed, I removed them from desire of hearing this assembly recite what the duties are that we should observe. You should not yield to anger.

sa: शोणितं निर्वमन्ति स्म द्विपाः पार्थशराहताः। सहस्रशश्छिन्नगात्राः सारोहाः सपदानुगाः॥
en: Thousands of elephants with their bodies mangled and their riders and those who followed them, having been struck with the arrows of Pritha's son, vomitted blood.

sa: सुखप्रसुप्तं कालाग्नि विबोधयितुमिच्छसि। न्यस्य चापं निवर्तस्व प्राणान्न जहिमद्गतः॥
en: You wish to rouse a fire slumbering sweetly. Leaving alone your bow, do you return. Do not lose your life by coming in contact with me.

sa: रथचक्रं प्रगृह्याजौ मुमोचाधिरथिं प्रति। तदापतद् वै सहसा कालचक्रमिवोद्यतम्॥
en: And taking up a car-wheel, discharged it at the son of Adhiratha. That (wheel), which was careering impetuously (towards him), like the upraised wheel of Death.

sa: अथैनं पञ्चभिर्बाणैराजधान स्तनान्तरे। भीमो भीमबलो राजंस्त्व दुर्मत्रितेन च॥
en: Then, Oking, Bhima of awful prowess, pierced Kritavarman, on the centre of his breast, with five arrows. All this is the result of your wicked policy.

sa: रात्र्या यया वाभिजिताच लोका भवन्ति कामाभिजिताः सुखाचा नरण्यसंस्थो भवितुं यतात्मा॥ दशैव पूर्वान् दश चापरांश्च ज्ञातीनथात्मानमथैकविंशम्। अरण्यवासी सुकृते दधाति विमुच्यारण्ये स्वशरीरधातून्॥
en: A learned should adopt the Vanaprastha mode of life, after the performance of the necessary rites. He should adopt it when he has been able to control his thirst for enjoyments and desire of acquiring wealth. When a man dies in the forest, leading the Vanaprastha mode of life, he mixes his ancestors and grand-children, numbering ten generations including himself, with the divine man essence.

sa: जातकर्मादिसंस्कारं कण्वः पुण्यकृतां वरः। विधिवत् कारयामास वर्धमानस्य धीमतः॥
en: The best of pious men, Kanvas, performed all the rites ordained by the scriptures on that intelligent boy who began to grow up day by day.

sa: जीवितं यस्य धर्मार्थं धर्मो हर्यर्थमेव च। अहोरात्राश्च पुण्यार्थं तं देवा ब्राह्मणं विदुः॥
en: The gods regard him as a Brahmana whose life is for the practice of righteousness, whose righteousness is for the behoof of them who wait dutifully upon him, and whose days and nights exist only for acquiring religious merit.

sa: तौ नखैरिव शार्दूलौ दन्तैरिव महाद्विपौ॥ रथशक्तिभिरन्योन्यं विशिखैश्च ततक्षतुः।
en: Then like two tigers mangling each other with claws or two elephants with their tusks, they mangled each other with their lances and arrows and javelins.

sa: महीधर इवोदग्रस्त्रिशृङ्गो भरतर्षभ।॥ सुस्राव चास्य रुधिरं विद्धस्य परमेषुभिः।
en: A mighty mountain with its three peaks towering high. Pierced as he was with those excellent arrows, streams of blood began to flow down his person.

sa: भीष्मद्रोणकृपादींश्च प्रवेक्ष्यन्त्यपरेऽसुराः। यैराविष्टा घृणां त्यक्त्वा योत्स्यन्ते तव वैरिभिः॥
en: Other Asura will possess Bhishma, Drona and Karna and others. Possessed by the Asuras, those heroes will cast away their kindness and fight with your enemies.

sa: जग्मुः स्वान्येव स्थानानि पूजयित्वा जलेश्वरम्। अभिषिक्तस्ततो देवैर्वरुणोऽपि महायशाः॥
en: Installed by the celestials, the illustrious Varuna began to duly protect seas and lakes and rivers and others reservoirs of water as Indra protects the gods.

sa: उत्तङ्क उवाच प्रतिग्राह्यो मतो मे त्वं सदैव पुरुषर्षभ। सोऽहं त्वामनुसम्प्राप्तो भिक्षितुं मणिकुण्डले॥
en: Utanka said O foremost of men, O Saudasa, in my estimation you are a worthy person from whom gifts may be accepted. I have, therefore, come to you for begging of you the jewelled earrings (worn by your queen).

sa: वरेण्य वरदानन्त अगतीनां गतिर्भव। पुराणपुरुष प्राणमनोवृत्त्याद्यगोचर॥ सर्वाध्यक्ष पराध्यक्ष त्वामहं शरणं गता। पाहि मां कृपया देव शरणागतवत्सल॥
en: O worshipful one, O endless giver of boons, you are the refuge of the helpless; You are the ancient Purusha, the vital breath, beyond the perception of mental faculties. Oh lord of all, the most excellent lord, I seek your refuge; O lord, O you fond of your votaries, kindly protect me.

sa: इत्युवाच स्वयं शक्रः सह ब्रह्मादिभिस्तदा। तचानुमोदितं सर्वं ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वरैः॥
en: This was said by Shakra himself about the glory of Kurukshetra. All that Shakra said was again approved and sanctioned by Brahman, Vishnu, and Maheshivara. as

sa: प्रत्युवाच महातेजाः कालयुक्तमिदं वचः। अलमेष महाबाहुः कर्णायैकोऽपि पाण्डव।॥
en: And great energy, replied (to him) in words suited to the occasion “O Pandava, this mighty arıncd one (Satyaki) is alone capable of fighting with Karna.

sa: तथैवान्ये महेष्वासा ये च तस्यानुयायिनः। मुमुचुः शरवर्षाणि धनंजयवधैषिणः॥
en: The other great bowmen, who followed the king and who were all desirous of bringing about the destruction of Dhananjaya, shot showers of arrows on him.

sa: धातुप्रस्यन्दिनः शैलाद् यथा गैरिकधातवः॥ किंचिद् विचलितः कर्णः सुप्रहाराभिपीडितः।
en: Like streams of liquefied red chalk flowing down the sides of a mountain. Afflicted with that might wound inflicted by Bhima, Karna was a little flurried.

sa: शूरोऽहमिति चात्मानमवगच्छसि दुर्मते। नैव लज्जास्ति ते सीतां चौरवद्ध्यपकर्षतः॥
en: O wicked-minded one, you think of yourself, 'I am a hero; but you that have taken way Sītā like a thief, have no feeling of shame.

sa: एतश्चान्यच्च बहुशो ब्रुवाणाः परमर्षय: 1॥ जातकौतूहलास्तत्र विमानस्ताश्च देवताः। ददृशुर्वाहिनीं तेषां राक्षसानां गतायुषाम्॥
en: And saying this as well as various other things, the supreme saints and the celestials stationed in the sky conceiving curiosity (as to the issue of the conflict), beheld the host of those Rākşasas, whose days had been numbered.

sa: चरणक्षालने कृष्णो ब्राह्मणानां स्वयं ह्यभूत। सर्वलोकसमावृत्तः पिप्रीषुः फलमुत्तमम्॥
en: Krishna, the centre of all men, with the desire of gaining the excellent fruit, him-self willingly took the task of washing the feet of the Brahmanas.

sa: ततश्चेदिपतेर्वाक्यं श्रुत्वा तत् कुरुसत्तमः। भीमसेनमुवाचेदं भीष्मो मतिमतां वरः॥
en: Having heard these words of the king of the Chedis, that foremost of the Kurus, that best of all intelligent men, Bhishma thus spoke to Bhima.

sa: तदाऽऽसीत् तुमुलं युद्धं निघ्नतामितरेतरम्। महाबलानां बलिभिर्दानवानां यथा सुरैः॥
en: Then there ensued a dreadful battle, like that between the celestials and the Danavas, in which mighty warriors engaged with mighty antagonists smote down one another.

sa: विव्यधुः सोमकास्तूर्णं समन्ताच्छरवृष्टिभिः। तत्र द्रोणोऽहरत् प्राणान् क्षत्रियानां विशाम्पते॥
en: The Somakas from all side began to pierce him with showers of arrows. Then Drona snatched out of the Kshatriyas their lives, O ruler of men.

sa: ततो युधिष्ठिरः क्षिप्रं गुरुतो राजसत्तमः। अपायाज्जवनैरश्वैः पाञ्चाल्यो द्रोणमभ्ययात्॥
en: Then that foremost of kings Yudhishthira speedily fled away from the preceptor being borne by his fleet steeds. Then the prince of the Panchalas charged Drona.

sa: आजैश्चापि,च वाराहैर्निष्ठानवरसंचयैः। फलनिषूहसंसिद्धैः सूपैर्गन्धरसान्वितैः॥ पुष्पध्वजवतीः पूर्णाः शुक्लस्यानस्य चाभितः। ददृशुर्विस्मितास्तत्र नरा लौहीः सहस्रशः॥
en: And the people with wonder beheld before them vessels of precious metals by thousands graceful with chaplets of flowers, filled with essences of fruits and fragrant soups and curries and the flesh of goats and bears, and white rice.

sa: तस्यां रात्र्यां व्यतीतायामभिषिच्य हुताग्निकान्। आपृच्छेतां नरव्याघ्रौ तापसान् वनगोचरान्॥
en: On the night having passed away, those foremost of men, after performing their ablutions, enquired of the ascetics performing fire sacrifices, who lived in the forest.

sa: यदाप्रभृति चाक्रान्ता दिगियं पुण्यकर्मणा। तदाप्रभृति निर्वैराः प्रशान्ता रजनीचराः॥
en: Ever since that one of pious ways possessed himself of this quarter, the rangers of the night have foregone their hostility, and assumed a peaceful attitude.

sa: गृहीत्वा क्षीरमेकाहा सुकुमारवपुस्तदा। अजयत् स्वेन वीर्येण दैत्यसैन्यगणान् विभुः॥
en: Having drunk the milk, that lord although then possessed of a tender frame, by virtue of his inbom prowess in one day vanquished the Dänava forces.

sa: निमित्तं लक्षणं स्वप्नं शकुनिस्वरदर्शनम्। अवश्यं सुखदुःखेषु नराणां परिदृश्यते॥
en: Throbbings of the eyes or other parts of the body, dreams, seeing birds or hearing their voice, are found to augur happiness or misery to men.

sa: ते प्रविश्य तु तं भीमं लतागुल्मसमावृतम्॥ ददृशुर्भीमकर्माणमसुरं सुरनिर्भयम्।
en: And entering (into a wood), they saw a terrible Asura, concealed by the shrubs and plants-of dreadful deeds, and cherishing no fear even of the gods.

sa: राजा दशरथो नाम द्युतिमान् धर्मवत्सलः। चातुर्वण्र्यं स्वधर्मेण नित्यमेवाभिपालयन्॥
en: There was a king named Dasaratha. Possessed of effulgence, and attached to righteousness, he, in consonance with his proper duties, for aye, governed the four orders.

sa: राजानं मानुषं प्राहुर्देवत्वे सम्मतो मम। यस्य धर्मार्थसहितं वृत्तमाहुरमानुषम्॥
en: Although a king observing interest and virtue, and who towers above average humanity, has been called a mortal, yet to me he is a very deity.

sa: स्वगात्रप्रभवे वीर शेषे रुधिरमण्डले॥ कृमिरागपरिस्तोमे स्वकीये शयने यथा।
en: O hero, you are lying down in a pool of blood issuing out of your own person, like to your own bed having a red-dyed bed-sheet.

sa: तं समीक्ष्य व्यवसितं पितुर्निर्देशपालने। कौसल्या बाष्पसंरुद्धा वचो धर्मिष्ठमब्रवीत्॥
en: Seeing Räma determined upon carrying out his father's behest's, Kausalya with her voice choked with vapour begot of tears, spoke to him the following pious words.

sa: कथमात्मसुतान् हित्वा त्रायसेऽन्यसुतं विभो। अकार्यमिव पश्यामः श्वमांसमिव भोजने॥
en: O lord, how, neglecting your own sons, you desire to deliver that of another? This we consider as heinous, even like to eating one's own flesh.

sa: सा रामं पर्णशालायामुपविष्टं परंतपम्। सीतया सह दुर्धर्षमब्रवीत् काममोहिता॥
en: Thereupon as that subduer of enemies, the irrepressible Rāma, was seated in the cottage in company with Sītā, the Rākşasī, transported with lust, said to him.

sa: कच्चित् स्वादुकृतं भोज्यमेको नाश्नासि राघव। कच्चिदाशंसमानेभ्यो मित्रेभ्यः सम्प्रयच्छसि॥
en: And, O son of Raghu, you do not alone partake of sapid meats yourself alone? And do you share them with those friends who expect it?

sa: यवीयानात्मनः पुत्रः शिष्यश्चापि गुणोदितः। पुत्रवत्ते त्रयश्चिन्त्या धर्मश्चैवात्र कारणम्॥
en: A younger brother, a son and an accomplished follower should always be regarded as sons. And virtue is always at the bottom of all such considerations.

sa: प्रविशन्तौ कदायोध्यां द्रक्ष्यामि शुभकुण्डलौ। उदग्रायुधनिस्त्रिंशौ सशृङ्गाविव पर्वतौ ॥
en: When shall I behold those (two) wearing burnished ear-rings, entering Ayodhyā, placing before them their weapons and swords, like unto two hills furnished with their summits?

sa: एवं प्रवाजितश्चैव रामोऽरामो भविष्यति। भरतश्च गतामित्रस्तव राजा भविष्यति॥
en: Thus banished Rāma will no longer maintain possession of the hearts of the people; and your Bharata with his foes put out, will be the king.

sa: नाधस्तादवनौ नाप्सु गतिर्नोपरि चाम्बरे। कस्यचित् सज्जतेऽस्माकं कपीश्वर तवाज्ञया॥
en: O lord of monkeys, who is there among us, who shall not at your command proceed to : water, sky or the region under the earth?

sa: विंशद्भुजं दशग्रीवं दर्शनीयपरिच्छदम्। विशालवक्षसं वीरं राजलक्षणलक्षितम्॥ नद्धवैदूर्यसंकाशं तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणम्। सुभुजं शुक्लदशनं महास्यं पर्वतोपमम्॥
en: Having twenty hands, and ten heads, wearing elegant attire; broad breasted; heroic; marked with royal signs; (in hue) resembling cool lapises; embellished. in ornaments of burnished gold; having goodly hands, white teeth, and a huge face resembling a hill.

sa: दशवर्षसहस्राणि तपस्तप्त्वा महावने॥ पुरा स्वयम्भुवे धीरः शिरांस्युपजहार यः।
en: Who, possessed of calmness, having formerly for ten thousand years carried on asceticism in the mighty forest, offered his own heads to the self create one;

sa: दीर्घगम्भीरनिर्घोषाः शैलदुमपुरोगमाः। विसृज्य सलिलं मेघाः परिशान्ता नृपात्मज ॥
en: O son of a king, the clouds, muttering a long and deep sound and approaching the hills and frees, are calmed having discharged their liquid contents.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा परमक्रुद्धो दण्डमुद्यम्य सत्वरः। विधूम इव कालाग्निर्यमदण्डमिवापरम् ॥
en: Saying this, he, transported with wrath, and like the smoking flame at at universal dissolution, speedily upraised a staff resembling another mace of Yama itself.' to

sa: पावकस्य सुतः श्रीमान् नीलोऽग्निसदृशप्रभः। तेजसा यशसा वीर्यादत्यरिच्यत वीर्यवान्॥
en: Agni beget as his son the powerful and graceful Nīla in effulgence like to the fire, who surpassed even his sire in energy, prowess, and renown.

sa: विधूमामिव हेमाभां शिखामग्नेः समुत्थिताम्। हविरभ्युक्षितां पश्चाच्छिखां विप्रलयं गताम्॥
en: Resembling a flame of fire devoid of smoke and streaming up in golden splendour, next sprinkled with clarified butter, and lastly appearing with its crest extinguished.

sa: शत्रवस्तव सुव्यक्तं हीनवीर्या निशाचर। इच्छन्ति त्वं विनस्यन्तमुपरुद्धं बलीयसा॥
en: O Ranger of night surely do your weak enemies wish to bring about your destruction by making you enter into a conflict with a powerful man.

sa: सोऽहं विश्राममिच्छामि पुत्रं कृत्वा प्रजाहिते। संनिकृष्टानिमान् सर्वाननुमान्य द्विजर्षभान्॥
en: I therefore wish for rest, after in the interests of the subjects installing my son, with the permission of all these excellent twice-born ones around me.

sa: उत्थास्यति च मेदिन्याः कृपणः पांसुगुण्ठितः। विनिःश्वसन् प्रस्रवणात् करेणूनामिवर्षभः॥
en: Covered with dust, he heaving sighs will rise from the ground in sad guise, like a leader of she-elephants rising from the side of a mountain.

sa: अस्माद्धंसा जलक्लिन्नाः पक्षैः सलिलरेणुभिः। कुरराः सारसाश्चैव निष्पतन्ति पतत्त्रिणः॥
en: And (it came to pass that) from this (cave) came out swans, drenched with water, with drops of water on their wings,-and plumed kuravas and cranes.

sa: कथं तच्चन्द्रसंकाशं मुखमासीन्मनोहरम्। सीतया कानि चोक्तानि तस्मिन्काले द्विजोत्तम॥
en: O you best of birds, how looked the moonlike, pleasant countenance of Sītā at the time of her being carried away? What did she speak then?

sa: सागरौघनिभा सेना भरतस्य महात्मनः। महीं संछादयामास प्रावृषि द्यामिवाम्बुदः॥
en: And that army of the high-souled Bharata resembling the waves of the ocean, covered the earth quite, as clouds in the rainy season cover the welkin.

sa: भक्षयित्वा विशालाक्षीमास्ते सीतां यथासुखम्। एनं वधिष्ये दीप्ताग्रैः शरघोरैरजिह्मगैः॥
en: This Rākşasa has been reposing at ease after devouring that one of expansive eyes; I shall kill him with terrible straight coursing arrows, having flaming points.

sa: ततो निपतिता तारां च्युतां तारामिवाम्बरात्। शनैराश्वासयामास हनुमान् हरियूथपः॥
en: Thereupon beholding Tārā fallen (on the ground) like to a star dropt down from the sky, Hanumān, the lord of monkey-herds, consoled her again and again.

sa: वसतस्तस्य रामस्य वने वनचरैः सह॥ ऋषयोऽभ्यागमन् सर्वे वधायासुररक्षसाम्।
en: While Rāma was dwelling there with the rangers of forests, the sages came to him in a body, for the destruction of the Asuras and Raksasas.

sa: सा तेनेक्ष्वाकुनाथेन पुरी सुपरिरक्षिता। यथा पुरस्तान्मनुना मानवेन्द्रेण धीमता॥
en: That city was ably govered by Dasaratha that lord of Ikşvāku's line, even as that foremost of men, the intelligent Manu, had governed it before him.

sa: क्षत्रं ब्रह्ममुखं चासीत् वैश्याः क्षत्रमनुव्रताः। शूद्राः स्वकर्मनिरतास्त्रीन् वर्णानुपचारिणः॥
en: The Kşatriyas were obedient the Brahmanas, and the Vaisyas followed the Kșatriyas, and the sadras, occupied with their proper vocations, ministered to the three other orders.

sa: स्वकर्मनिरता नित्यं ब्राह्मणा विजितेन्द्रियाः। दानाध्ययनशीलाश्च संयताश्च प्रतिग्रहे ॥
en: The Brāhmaṇas of subdued senses were always engaged in the performance of their own duties, giving away in charity, and studying, and receiving gifts with discrimination.

sa: एष दाशरथी रामः सत्यवाञ्छीलवाञ्शुचिः। रक्षसा रौद्ररूपेण ह्रियते सहलक्ष्मणः॥
en: Rāma, the son of Dasaratha, the strong, the truthful and the pure, is, along with Laksmana, being carried away by you, Rākşasa of a terrible appearance.

sa: अभिदुतमिवारण्ये सिंहेन गजयूथपम्। प्रच्छाद्यमानं रामेण भरतं त्रातुमर्हसि ॥
en: Therefore it behoves you to save Bharata about to be overcome by Rāma, like a lion pursuing the leader of an elephant herd in a forest.

sa: तिर्यगूर्ध्वमधश्चैव शक्तिस्ते शैल वर्धितुम्। तस्मात् संचोदयामि त्वामुत्तिष्ठ गिरिसत्तम॥
en: O mountain, you are capable of expanding yourself upwards, downwards and on they sides. I do command you therefore, O best of mountains, to rise up.

sa: निशि भान्त्यचलेन्द्रस्य हुताशनशिखा इव। ओषध्यः स्वप्रभालक्ष्म्या भ्राजमानाः सहस्रशः॥
en: In the night, the annual herbs by thousands growing on this foremost of hills, shine and become visible by their own lustre, like flames of fire.

sa: स यातस्तेजसा व्योम संक्षिपन्निव वेगितः। अथाहं खेचरैर्भूतैरभिगम्य सभाजितः॥
en: And summoning celerity, he went on as if pushing off the sky by his energy. Then the rangers of the air and other beings worshipped me.

sa: सुप्रीतो भगवान् ब्रह्मा प्रजानां प्रभुरीश्वरः॥ ततः सुरगणैः सार्धमुपागम्य पितामहः। भगीरथं महात्मानं तप्यमानमथाब्रवीत्॥
en: And thereat that possessor of the six attributes and lord of all creatures, Brahmā, was well pleased with that high-souled monarch. And presenting himself together with the celestials, the Grand-sire thus spoke to the high-souled Bhagiratha engaged in austerities.

sa: अगत्वा निश्चयं राजा तेषामुद्धरणं प्रति। व्याधिना नरशार्दूल कालधर्ममुपेयिवान्॥
en: And without having arrived at any definite decision in regard to their deliverance, the king, O puissant one, being attacked with an ailment, breathed his last.

sa: इह तु स्थण्डिले शीघ्रं कुशानास्तर सारथे। आर्य प्रत्युपवेक्ष्यामि यावन्मे सम्प्रसीदति॥ निराहारो निरालोको धनहीनो यथा द्विजः। शये पुरस्ताच्छालायां यावन्मां प्रतियास्यति ॥
en: O charioteer, do you speedily spread Kuša on the ground here. I will remain near the noble one until he be kindly disposed (towards me). Even as a twice born one deprived of his wealth Leith down (at the door of an unrighteous person), eschewing food and in darkness, will I lie down in front of this cottage, until he betakes himself back (to Ayodhyā)

sa: योजनानां सहस्राणि षष्ठिं तु रघुनन्दन। बिभिदुर्धरणी राम रसातलमनुत्तमम्॥
en: O descendant of Raghu, they excavated the earth, O Rāma, for sixty thousand Yojanas, you, as if they had intended to reach the lowest depths underground.

sa: विभवश्चास्य सुमहानासीद् धनपतेरिव। एवं गुस्धन विद्वन् दानेनैव विशोधय॥
en: His wealth is as great as that of the lord of riches and O learned man, repay your debt by accepting this large wealth as present.

sa: दृश्यन्ते हि महात्मानो बध्यमानाः स्वकर्मभिः। इन्द्रियाणामनीशत्वाद् राजानो राज्यविभ्रमैः॥
en: Instances are seen in which noble hearted kings, out of lust of territory, are destroyed by acts sorely through the want of control over their senses.

sa: असहायोऽसि कौन्तेय ससहायाश्च कौरवाः। अतएव महाबाहो भीतस्तिष्ठामि तेऽग्रतः॥
en: You have none to help you, O son of Kunti, but Kurus have many to help them. Therefore, O mighty-armed hero, I wait before you afraid.

sa: रथादतिरथं शूरं सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरम्। विवशं पार्थमादास्ये गरुत्मानिव पन्नगम्॥
en: From my car I shall get hold of the unresisting Partha, a heroic car-warrior and the foremost of the holders of weapon like Garuda catching snakes.

sa: देवराडपि गन्धर्वान् मृतांस्तान् समजीवयत्। दिव्येनामृतवर्षेण ये हताः कौरवैर्युधि॥
en: The lord of the celestials then came there and vivified with the celestials Ambrosia all those Gandharvas that were killed in the battle with the Kurus.

sa: धर्मार्थो यः परित्यज्य स्यादिन्द्रियवशानुगः। श्रीप्राणधनदारेभ्यः क्षिप्रं स परिहीयते॥
en: He, who having forsaken both virtue and worldly gains, the follows, the lead of his senses, very soon comes to lose prosperity, life wealth and wife.

sa: असाधना वापि ससाधना वा समानमेतद् दृश्यते मानुषेषु। समानमेतदमृतस्येतरस्य मुक्तास्तत्र मध्व उत्सं समापुः। योगिनस्तं प्रपश्यन्ति भगवन्तं सनातनम्॥
en: It is seen equally among men who have obtained true knowledge and those that have not. It is present equally in men that have obtained immortality and others (i.e. those who have not) but the emancipated ones obtain honey flowing in a thick stream. The ascetics perceive that Lord who is Eternal.

sa: कुन्तिभोज पुरा राजन् ब्राह्मणः पर्युपस्थितः। तिग्मतेजा महाप्रांशुः श्मश्रुदण्डजटाधरः॥
en: Formerly, O monarch, there came a highlyenergetic Brahmana to Kuntibhoja. He was tall in stature, wore beard and matted locks, carried a staff in his hand.

sa: वैश्योऽधिगम्य वित्तानि ब्रह्मकर्माणि कारयेत्। शूद्रः शुश्रूषणं कुर्यात् त्रिषु वर्णेषु नित्यशः। वन्दनायोगविधिभिर्वैतसी वृत्तिमास्थितः॥
en: Having amassed wealth the Vaishyas should perform the Vedic rites there with. A Shudra should always attend to and serve the other three orders, having recourse to flattery as the means of livelihood and behaving (cringlingly) like the cane.

sa: अक्षौहिण्यश्च सप्तैव धर्मपुत्रस्य संगताः। युयुत्समानाः कुरुभिः प्रतीक्षन्तेऽस्य शासनम्॥
en: Seven Akshauhinis have been collected for the son of Dharma (Yudhishthira), they all desirous of fighting with the sons of Kuru, are waiting for his permission.

sa: हेमत्सरुरनाधृष्यो नैषध्यो भारसाधनः। कस्य पाचनखे कोशे सायको हेमविग्रहः॥
en: Whose is this sword made of gold, manufactured in the country of Nishadas, capable of bearing heavy weight and cased in a sheath of goat skin?

sa: ऋते वर्षान्न कौन्तेय जातु निवर्तयेत् फलम्। तत्र वै पौरुषं ब्रूयुरासेकं यत्र कारितम्॥
en: But without rain, O son of Kunti, it cannot be made to yield crops. In that case ( i.e. if there is no rain) it is said that irrigation, which can be done men, ought to be resorted to.

sa: सर्वकामदुधा नाम धेनुर्धारयते दिशम्। उत्तरां मातले धा तथैलविसंज्ञिताम्॥
en: The cow, named Sarvakamadugha, supports another point, O Matali, which is the direction in which virtue rules and so named after Kubera the God of wealth.

sa: मुहूर्तादेव चापश्यत् पुरुषं रक्तवाससम्। बद्धमौलिं वपुष्मन्तमादित्यसमतेजसम्॥ श्यामावदातं रक्ताक्षं पाशहस्तं भयावहम्। स्थितं सत्यवतः पार्श्वे निरीक्षन्तं तमेव च॥
en: And in a moment she saw a person attired in red garments, wearing a diadem, of an enormous structure, having the splendour of the sun of a dark and yellow complexion, endued with red eyes, with a noose in his hands, dreadful to look at, standing beside Satyavana and gazing at him.

sa: उदपानाश्च नर्दन्ति यथा गोवृषभास्तथा। धार्तराष्ट्रस्य सैन्येषु तत् पराभवलक्षणम्॥
en: Reservoirs of waters produce sounds similar to those of cows and bulls; that is a sign of defeat to the army of the son of Dhritarashtra.

sa: इयं कन्या नरश्रेष्ठ हर्यश्व प्रतिगृह्यताम्। चतुर्भागेन शुल्कस्य जनयस्वैकमात्मजम्॥
en: Accept this maiden, O Haryashva, O foremost among men, by the offer of a fourth part of her dowry and beget on her but one child."

sa: अग्निरेष महार्चिष्पाञ्जागर्ति वारुणे ह्रदे। वैष्णवं चक्रमाविद्धं विधूमेन हविष्मता॥
en: There are the fire of blazing flame which is burning in the lake of Varuna and the discus of Vishnu surrounded by the fire and smoke.

sa: सर्वेषां तात भूतानां विनाशे प्रत्युपस्थिते। अनयो नयसंकाशो हृदयानापसर्पति॥
en: When the destruction of all creatures, my dear friend, is at hand, that which/is wrong is not removed from the heart, having the appearance of right.

sa: चतुर्थेऽहनि मर्तव्यमिति संचिन्त्य भाविनी। व्रतः त्रिरात्रमुद्दिश्य दिवारानं स्थिताभवत्॥
en: Having ascertained (by calculation) that her husband's death would take place on the fourth day (thence), that observant of the Triratra vow, fasted day and night.

sa: वनेषु मृगवासेषु व्याघ्रविप्रोषितेषु च। दावाग्निविप्रयुक्तेषु शून्येषु गहनेषु च॥
en: And roaming in thick forests from which the kings of animals (lions) and tigers had been exiled and in deserts which had no conflagration in them,

sa: आगोपालाविपालाश्च नन्दमाना युधिष्ठिरम्। पञ्चाला: केकया मत्स्याः प्रतिनन्दन्ति पाण्डवम्॥
en: Down to the very herdsmen who look after cattle and sheep, the tribes of Panchalas, Kaikeya and Matsyas gladden the heart of Yudhishthira, the Pandu king.

sa: निष्यतन्तो रथात् तस्य धौता हिरण्यवाससः। आकाशे समदृश्यन्त हंसानामिवपङ्क्तयः॥
en: The white arrows with golden wings appears as a row of swans in the sky when they flew from the side where Arjuna's chariot was existed.

sa: एकस्मिन्नेव जायेते कुले क्लीबमहाबलौ। फलाफलवती शाखे यथैकस्मिन् वनस्पतौ॥
en: In the same family are born very powerful men and powerless ones, as the same forest contains trees that bear fruits and those that do not.

sa: महेष्वासा राजपुत्रा भ्रातरः पञ्च केकयाः। आमुक्तकवचाः शूरास्तैश्च वस्तेऽभ्ययुञ्जत॥
en: With those five Kaikeya princes, brothers to one another and mighty bowmen, with these heroes; with the coats of arms on will they fight with you.

sa: कथं हि धर्मराजस्य दोषमल्पमपि ब्रुवन्। लभते परिषन्मध्ये व्याहर्तुमकुतोभयः॥
en: How can one, who even in the slightest degree speaks ill of the virtuous king, dare continue in that stain without being checked, in this assembly.

sa: श्रद्धया परया राजन्नुपनीतानि सत्कृतिम्। प्रवृत्तानि महाप्राज्ञ धर्मिणां पुण्यकर्मिणाम्॥
en: These things, O king, the wise and virtuous men attached to the performance of pious acts ever keep ready for offering with reverence to their guests.

sa: अथ जिष्णुरुपावृत्य क्षुरधारेण कार्मुकम्। चकर्त भीष्मस्य तदा जातरूपपरिष्कृतम्॥
en: The victorious Arjuna then marched closer to Bhishma and cut in pieces the gold studded bow of him by shooting an arrow having sword like blade.

sa: सहदेवस्तु संयाय रथेन गजयोधिनः। पातयामास नाराचैर्दुमेभ्य इव बर्हिणः॥
en: From his chariot, Sahadeva began to cut down with his iron arrows, many heroes fighting on elephants like birds dropped from the branches of a tree.

sa: उभौ जघ्नतुरन्योन्यमुभौ भूमौ निपेततुः। उभौ ववल्गतुश्चित्रं मुष्टिभिश्च निजघ्नतुः॥
en: Both smote each other and both struck down each other on the ground; both moved about with wonderful (dexterity) and both dealt blows (at each other).

sa: मन्ये पर्यायधर्मोऽयं कालस्यात्यन्तगामिनः। चक्रे प्रधिरिवासक्तो नास्य शक्यं पलायितुम्॥
en: I consider this to be the work of Eternal Time. I am not able to fly from it like the iron ring attached to the wheel.

sa: र्मा तेऽन्तरं रिपव: प्रार्थयन्तु। सत्ये स्थितास्ते नरदेव सर्वे दुर्योधनं स्थापय त्वं नरेन्द्र॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, make peace with the sons of Pandu; let not your enemies pry into your internal relations; they are all attached to truth. O god among men, O king among men, make Duryodhana renounce his ways.

sa: राज्यं तु पाण्डोरिदमप्रधृष्यं तस्याद्य पुत्राः प्रभवन्ति नान्ये। राज्यं तदेतन्निखिलं पाण्डवानां पैतामहं पुत्रपौत्रानुगामि॥
en: This kingdom, incapable of being subjugated, belongs to Pandu and now his sons are lords over it and none else. This entire kingdom, coming from their father, goes to the sons of Pandu, and to their sons of grandsons.

sa: पित्र्यं राज्यं महाराज कुरुवस्ते सजाङ्गलाः। अथ वीरैर्जितामुर्वीमखिलां प्रत्यपद्यथाः॥
en: The country of the Kurus, with Jangala, O great king, is your ancestral kingdom; but you have possessed yourself the entire kingdom subjugated by the heroes.

sa: स चैनं प्रतिजग्राह विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा। सुखोपविष्टं विश्रान्तमथैनं विदुरोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Vidura, too, received him by the rites prescribed by custom; and Vidura addressed him when he (the latter) was seated at his ease and taking rest.

sa: तमुपस्थितमाज्ञाय रथं दिव्यं महामनाः। महाभ्रघननिर्घोषं सर्वरत्नविभूषितम्॥ अग्नि प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा ब्राह्मणांश्च जनार्दनः। कौस्तुभं मणिमामुच्य श्रिया परमया ज्वलन्॥ कुरुभिः संवृतः कृष्णो वृष्णिभिश्चाभिरक्षितः। आतिष्ठत रथं शौरिः सर्वयादवनन्दनः॥
en: That one large mind, understanding that the celestial car ornamented with all sorts of gems and precious stones and whose wheels rattled as loudly as masses of thick clouds, had arrived. Made tour round the fire and also round the Brahmanas. And putting on the Kaustubha gem which was shining with excellent beauty and surrounded by the Kurus and protected by the Vrishnis, Krishna or Shauri the center of delight of all the Yadavas mounted on his car.

sa: उभयोः साधयन्नर्थमहमागत इत्युत। तत्र यत्नमहं कृत्वा गच्छेयं नृष्ववाच्यताम्॥
en: And for being of service to both the parties have I come here. And having made attempts in that direction I shall escape blame of men.

sa: द्विडनीकेषु बीभत्सोर्न ससज्जे रथस्तदा॥ स तद् विक्षोभयामास ह्यरातिबलवासा।
en: So the car of Bibhatsu was not obstructed by the army of the enemy. He, with great force, began to agitate the army of the enemy.

sa: सुखं प्रतिप्रबुद्धानामिन्द्रियाण्युपलक्षये। स भवान् सुहृदोऽस्माकमथवा न: पिता भवान्॥
en: Their organs of sense indicate as if they have awakened from an agreeable slumber. Are you a friend of ours or are you our father himself?

sa: वपुष्मती वोरगराजकन्या वनेचरी वा क्षणदाचरस्त्री। यद्येव राज्ञो वरुणस्य पत्नी यमस्य सोमस्य धनेश्वरस्य॥
en: Or a daughter of the king of serpents or the wife of a night ranger or the wife of Varuna or of Yama or of Soma or of Kubera who assuming a human form are wandering in this forest?

sa: तस्मिन् विद्धे महेष्वासे कर्णे सर्वास्त्रकोविदे। हताश्वसूते विरथे ततोऽनीकमभज्यत॥
en: When that great bowman Karna expert in the use of all weapons, was thus pierced and his steeds, chariot and charioteer destroyed, his army were routed.

sa: यावद्धि सूच्यास्तीक्ष्णाया विध्येदग्रेण मारिष। तावदप्यपरित्याज्यं भूमेनः पाण्डवान् प्रति॥
en: That extent of land which is pierced by the extremity of a sharp needle, O venerable Sire, I shall not surrender to the sons of Pandu.

sa: निवृत्तसमयाः पार्था महात्मानो महाबलाः। महोत्साहा भविष्यन्ति पाण्डवा ह्यमितौजसः॥
en: When the time of their exile shall be over, the high-minded and the greatly powerful son of Pritha, of incomparable prowess, shall be brimful with energy.

sa: संजय उवाच आमन्त्रये त्वां नरदेवदेव गच्छाम्यहं पाण्डव स्वस्ति तेऽस्तु। दुच्चारितं मे मनसोऽभिषङ्गात्॥
en: Sanjaya said After bidding you adieu, O god among men, shall I go awayo lord, O son of Pandu, may it be well with you. Has any objectionable language been uttered by me, in the heat of the moment.

sa: सेनासमुदयं कृत्वा पार्थिवं मधुसूदन। कृतार्थं मन्यते बाल आत्मानमविचक्षणः॥
en: That boy, who is not shrewd having brought together a large army from this earth, regards himself as having already gained his object,o slayer of Madhu.

sa: धृतराष्ट्रात्मजः श्रीमानेष राजा सुयोधनः॥ एतस्याभिमुखं वीर रथं पररथारुजम्।
en: Is the son of Dhritarashtra, the graceful king Duryodhana. O hero, take before him this car that is capable of destroying other cars of the enemies.

sa: अतोऽन्यथा रथिना फाल्गुनेन भीमेन चैवाहवदंशितेन। परासिक्तान् धार्तराष्ट्रांश्च विद्धि प्रदह्यमानान् कर्मणा स्वेन पापान्॥
en: If it is otherwise, you may be sure, that the sons of Dhritarashtra who are being consumed by their own vicious deeds, will be rendered devoid of all prosperity by Arjuna in his car and Bhima equipped for fight.

sa: अग्निरुवाच अहमन्तःशरीरस्थो भूतानां रघुनन्दन। सुसूक्ष्ममपि काकुत्स्थ मैथिली नापराध्यति॥
en: Agni said: O scion of Raghu's race, I am in the body of every creature. O descendant of Kakustha, the princess of Videha is thoroughly guiltless.

sa: एवमुक्तः प्रत्युवाच धार्तराष्ट्रो जनार्दनम्। न युक्तं भवताऽस्मासु प्रतिपत्तुमसाम्प्रतम्॥
en: The son of Dhritarashtra, being thus spoken to, said in reply to Janardana-'It is not befitting that your exalted self should behave in this unjust way.

sa: दिशं धुंदीचीमपि चोत्तरान् कुरून् गाण्डीवधन्वैकरथो जिगाय। धनं चैषामाहरत् सव्यसाची सेनानुगान् द्रविडांश्चैव चक्रे॥
en: Seated on one car, with the help of the Gandiva bow, Savyasachin, having subjugated the Kauravas of the north and the northern country as well, took away their wealth and turned the people of Dravida into his soldier followers.

sa: ततोऽतिभीतगात्रस्तु शक्र आस्ते विचारयन्। अथाजगाम परशुं स्कन्धेनादाय वर्धकिः॥
en: For that reason fearful to behold. Shakra remained kept in thought. Then there came a wood cutter with an axe on his shoulder to that forest.

sa: विदुर उवाच शकुनीनामिहार्थाय पाशं भूमावयोजयत्। कश्चिच्छाकुनिकस्तात पूर्वेषामिति शुश्रुम॥
en: Vidura said For the capture of birds did a certain fowler set his net in this world. O Sire, so we have heard from old men.

sa: ततः स सैन्यमालोक्य वध्यमानमरातिभिः। मायावी चासृजन्मायां रावणो राक्षसाधिपः॥
en: Then, seeing that his troops were being destroyed by the enemy, Ravana, the king of the Rakshasas began to create illusions with which he was gifted.
